title.zh: 卷八十八 志第六十四 河渠六
title.raw: 卷八十八 志第六十四 河渠六 Volume 88 Treatises 64: Rivers and Canals 6

sentences.zh: 直省水利

translations.literal: Water conservancy in the directly administered provinces
translations.idiomatic: Water Conservancy in the Directly Administered Provinces

sentences.zh: 三代疆理水土之制甚詳。

translations.literal: The systems of the Three Dynasties for demarcating territory and managing water and soil were very detailed.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dynasties had elaborate institutions for surveying land and regulating water and soil.

sentences.zh: 自井田廢，溝遂堙，水常不得其治，於是穿鑿渠塘井陂，以資灌溉。

translations.literal: Since the well-field system was abolished, ditches and drains were filled in, and water often could not be properly managed; thereupon canals, ponds, wells, and embankments were dug and cut to supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Once the well-field system fell away and ditches and drains silted shut, water could seldom be brought under proper control, so people bored and cut canals, ponds, wells, and embankments to irrigate their fields.

sentences.zh: 明初，太祖詔所在有司，民以水利條上者，即陳奏。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming, the Taizu emperor ordered the local officials everywhere that whenever the people submitted items concerning water conservancy, they should at once memorialize them.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming, Taizu ordered officials in every locality to forward at once any waterworks proposals the people submitted.

sentences.zh: 越二十七年，特諭工部，陂塘湖堰可蓄泄以備旱潦者，皆因其地勢修治之。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven years later, he specially instructed the Ministry of Works that all ponds, lakes, and dams that could store and release water against drought and flood should be repaired according to local terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven years on, he expressly told the Ministry of Works to repair every pond, lake, and dam that could hold or release water against drought and flood, each according to the lay of the land.

sentences.zh: 乃分遣國子生及人材，遍詣天下，督修水利。

translations.literal: Thereupon students of the Imperial Academy and men of talent were dispatched separately to travel throughout the empire and supervise waterworks repairs.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent out Imperial Academy students and talented men across the realm to oversee hydraulic works.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，郡邑交奏。

translations.literal: The next winter, prefectures and counties submitted reports in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The following winter, prefectures and counties filed their reports one after another.

sentences.zh: 凡開塘堰四萬九百八十七處，其恤民者至矣。

translations.literal: In all, 40,987 ponds and dams were opened—his care for the people reached this extent.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 40,987 ponds and dams were opened—a measure of care for the people that could hardly be surpassed.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有所興築，或役本境，或資鄰封，或支官料，或採山場，或農隙鳩工，或隨時集事，或遣大臣董成。

translations.literal: Afterward, whenever construction was undertaken, sometimes labor was levied within the locality, sometimes resources were drawn from neighboring jurisdictions, sometimes official materials were disbursed, sometimes mountain lands were exploited, sometimes labor was mustered in slack farming seasons, sometimes work was gathered as occasion required, and sometimes great ministers were sent to direct completion.
translations.idiomatic: Later projects might conscript labor locally or draw help from neighboring districts, issue official supplies or quarry mountain materials, muster workers in farming slack seasons or assemble them as need arose, and sometimes a senior minister was sent to supervise the work through to completion.

sentences.zh: 終明世水政屢修，可具列云。

translations.literal: Throughout the Ming dynasty water administration was repeatedly repaired; the particulars may be fully listed as follows.
translations.idiomatic: Waterworks were repaired again and again through the Ming; the main undertakings may be set out as follows.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年修和州銅城堰閘，週迴二百餘里。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu the Tongcheng Dam sluice in He Prefecture was repaired, encircling more than two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 1 (1368): the Tongcheng Dam sluice in He Prefecture was repaired, enclosing more than two hundred li of land.

sentences.zh: 四年修興安靈渠，為陡渠者三十六。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Ling Canal at Xing'an was repaired, and thirty-six steep channels were made.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 4: the Ling Canal at Xing'an was repaired, with thirty-six stepped channels built.

sentences.zh: 渠水發海陽山，秦時鑿，溉田萬頃。

translations.literal: The canal water issues from Haiyang Mountain; it was cut in Qin times and irrigates fields of ten thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Its water rises on Haiyang Mountain; the Qin had cut the channel, which irrigated ten thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 馬援葺之，後圮。

translations.literal: Ma Yuan restored it, but later it collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuan had restored it, but it later fell into ruin.

sentences.zh: 至是始復。

translations.literal: At this time it was restored for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: Only now was it brought back into use.

sentences.zh: 六年發松江、嘉興民夫二萬開上海胡家港，自海口至漕涇千二百餘丈，以通海船，且浚海鹽澉浦。

translations.literal: In the sixth year twenty thousand laborers from Songjiang and Jiaxing were mobilized to open Shanghai's Hujia Harbor, from the estuary to Caojing more than 1,200 zhang, to admit seagoing vessels, and the coastal salt port of Ganpu was also dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 6: twenty thousand laborers from Songjiang and Jiaxing opened Hujia Harbor at Shanghai—more than 1,200 zhang from the estuary to Caojing—to admit seagoing craft, and the salt port of Ganpu was dredged as well.

sentences.zh: 八年開登州蓬萊閣河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the river at Penglai Pavilion in Dengzhou was opened.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 8: the river at Penglai Pavilion in Dengzhou was opened.

sentences.zh: 命耿炳文浚涇陽洪渠堰，溉涇陽、三原、醴泉、高陵、臨潼田二百餘里。

translations.literal: Geng Bingwen was ordered to dredge the Hong Canal dam at Jingyang, irrigating fields of more than two hundred li in Jingyang, Sanyuan, Liquan, Gaoling, and Lintong.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Bingwen was ordered to dredge the Hong Canal dam at Jingyang, watering more than two hundred li of fields in Jingyang, Sanyuan, Liquan, Gaoling, and Lintong.

sentences.zh: 九年修彭州都江堰。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Dujiangyan at Pengzhou was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 9: the Dujiangyan works at Pengzhou were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十二年，李文忠言：「陝西病鹹鹵，請穿渠城中，遙引龍首渠東注。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Li Wenzhong said: 'Shaanxi suffers from brackish salinity; I request to cut a canal within the city and draw the Longshou Canal from afar to pour eastward.'
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 12: Li Wenzhong memorialized, 'Shaanxi is plagued by brackish soil; I ask permission to cut a canal through the city and bring the Longshou Canal in from the east.'

sentences.zh: 」從其請，甃以石。

translations.literal: His request was granted, and it was faced with stone.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted, and the channel was lined with stone.

sentences.zh: 十四年築海鹽海塘。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the seawall at Haiyan was built.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 14: the seawall at Haiyan was built.

sentences.zh: 十七年築磁州漳河決堤。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the breached dike on the Zhang River at Cizhou was built up.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 17: the breached Zhang River dike at Cizhou was repaired.

sentences.zh: 決荊州嶽山壩以灌民田。

translations.literal: The Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou was breached to irrigate the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou was opened to water the people's fields.

sentences.zh: 十九年築長樂海堤。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the coastal dike at Changle was built.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 19: the coastal dike at Changle was built.

sentences.zh: 二十三年修崇明、海門決堤二萬三千九百餘丈，役夫二十五萬人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year breached dikes at Chongming and Haimen were repaired for more than 23,900 zhang, employing 250,000 laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 23: more than 23,900 zhang of breached dikes at Chongming and Haimen were repaired, with 250,000 workers employed.

sentences.zh: 四川永甯宣慰使言：「所轄水道百九十灘，江門大灘八十二，皆被石塞。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commissioner of Yongning in Sichuan said: 'Within my jurisdiction there are 190 rapids on the waterways, and 82 major rapids at Jiangmen, all blocked by rock.'
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Yongning in Sichuan reported, 'Within my jurisdiction are 190 shoals on the waterways, including 82 major ones at Jiangmen, all choked with rock.'

sentences.zh: 」詔景川侯曹震往疏之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan to go and dredge them.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan to go and clear them.

sentences.zh: 二十四年修臨海橫山嶺水閘，寧海、奉化海堤四千三百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the water sluice at Hengshan Ridge in Linhai was repaired, and sea dikes at Ninghai and Fenghua for more than 4,300 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 24: the sluice at Hengshan Ridge in Linhai was repaired, and more than 4,300 zhang of sea dikes at Ninghai and Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 築上虞海堤四千丈，改建石閘。

translations.literal: A sea dike of 4,000 zhang was built at Shangyu, and the stone sluice was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: A four-thousand-zhang sea dike was built at Shangyu, and the stone sluice was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 浚定海、鄞二縣東錢湖，灌田數萬頃。

translations.literal: East Qian Lake in Dinghai and Yin counties was dredged, irrigating fields of tens of thousands of qing.
translations.idiomatic: East Qian Lake in Dinghai and Yin counties was dredged, watering tens of thousands of qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 二十五年鑿溧陽銀墅東壩河道，由十字港抵沙子河胭脂壩四千三百餘丈，役夫三十五萬九千餘人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the channel of the eastern dam at Yinshu in Liyang was cut, from Shizi Harbor to the Yanzhi Dam on Shazi River for more than 4,300 zhang, employing 359,000-odd laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 25: the channel at the eastern dam of Yinshu in Liyang was cut—more than 4,300 zhang from Shizi Harbor to the Yanzhi Dam on the Shazi River—with 359,000-odd workers employed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年浚山陽支家河，鬱林州民言：「州南北二江相去二十餘里，乞鑿通，設石陡諸閘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Zhijia River in Shanyang was dredged; the people of Yulin Prefecture said: 'The two rivers north and south of the prefecture are more than twenty li apart; we beg to cut through and connect them and set up stone locks and other sluices.'
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 27: Zhijia River in Shanyang was dredged; the people of Yulin Prefecture petitioned, 'The north and south rivers of the prefecture lie more than twenty li apart; we ask that they be cut through and linked, with stone locks and other gates installed.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十九年修築河南洛堤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Luo River dike in Henan was built and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 29: the Luo River dike in Henan was built up.

sentences.zh: 復興安靈渠。

translations.literal: The Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored again.
translations.idiomatic: The Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored again.

sentences.zh: 時尚書唐鐸以軍興至其地，圖渠狀以聞。

translations.literal: At that time Minister Tang Duo, because of military mobilization, reached that place, drew a diagram of the canal's condition, and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Tang Duo happened to reach the place on military business, surveyed the canal, and memorialized with a diagram.

sentences.zh: 請浚深廣，通官舟以餉軍。

translations.literal: He requested dredging it deep and wide to admit official boats for supplying the army.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that it be dredged deep and wide so government transports could supply the army.

sentences.zh: 命御史嚴震直燒鑿陡澗之石，餉道果通。

translations.literal: Censor Yan Zhenzhi was ordered to burn and cut the rock of the steep gorges, and the supply route was indeed opened.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yan Zhenzhi was ordered to burn and cut through the rock of the steep gorges, and the supply route was duly opened.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，洪渠堰圮，復命耿炳文修治之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the Hong Canal dam collapsed; Geng Bingwen was again ordered to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 31: the Hong Canal dam collapsed, and Geng Bingwen was again ordered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 且浚渠十萬三千餘丈。

translations.literal: Moreover the canal was dredged for more than 103,000 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: More than 103,000 zhang of the canal were dredged as well.

sentences.zh: 建文四年疏吳淞江。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwen the Wusong River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen 4 (1402): the Wusong River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 命夏原吉治蘇、鬆、嘉興水患，浚華亭、上海運鹽河，金山衛閘及漕涇分水港。

translations.literal: Xia Yuanji was ordered to manage the water disasters of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Jiaxing, and to dredge the salt transport rivers of Huating and Shanghai, the sluice at Jinshan Guard, and the Caojing distributary harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yuanji was ordered to deal with flooding in Suzhou, Songjiang, and Jiaxing, and to dredge the salt transport rivers of Huating and Shanghai, the Jinshan Guard sluice, and the Caojing distributary.

sentences.zh: 原吉言：「浙西諸郡，蘇、鬆最居下流，嘉、湖、常頗高，環乙太湖，綿亙五百里。

translations.literal: Yuanji said: 'Among the prefectures of western Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang lie lowest downstream; Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou are rather high, encircling Lake Tai for five hundred li in extent.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji reported, 'Of the prefectures in western Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang lie lowest downstream, while Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou stand higher, all ringing Lake Tai across five hundred li.'

sentences.zh: 納杭、湖、宣、歙溪澗之水，散注澱山諸湖，以入三泖。

translations.literal: It receives the waters of streams and ravines from Hangzhou, Huzhou, Xuancheng, and Shezhou, dispersing them into the lakes such as Dianshan, to enter the Three Mo.
translations.idiomatic: It takes in streams from Hangzhou, Huzhou, Xuancheng, and Shezhou, channels them through lakes such as Dianshan, and sends them on into the Three Mo.

sentences.zh: 頃為浦港堙塞，漲溢害稼。

translations.literal: Recently estuary harbors have been blocked and silted, causing floods that harm the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the estuary channels have silted shut, and the backed-up water has ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 拯治之法，在浚吳淞諸浦。

translations.literal: The method of remedy lies in dredging the Wusong and various estuaries.
translations.idiomatic: The remedy is to dredge the Wusong and its tributary channels.

sentences.zh: 按吳淞江袤二百餘里，廣百五十餘丈，西接太湖，東通海，前代常疏之。

translations.literal: The Wusong River extends more than two hundred li in length and is more than 150 zhang wide; west it joins Lake Tai, east it reaches the sea; former dynasties often dredged it.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong River runs more than two hundred li and is over 150 zhang wide, joining Lake Tai on the west and the sea on the east; earlier dynasties dredged it regularly.

sentences.zh: 然當潮汐之沖，旋疏旋塞。

translations.literal: Yet it lies in the path of the tidal bore, so no sooner is it dredged than it silts again.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it lies in the path of the tides, so no sooner is it cleared than it silts up again.

sentences.zh: 自吳江長橋抵下界浦，百二十餘里，水流雖通，實多窄淺。

translations.literal: From Chang Bridge in Wujiang to Xiajie Harbor, more than 120 li, the current though flowing is in fact often narrow and shallow.
translations.idiomatic: From Chang Bridge in Wujiang to Xiajie Harbor—a stretch of more than 120 li—the water flows, but much of the channel is narrow and shallow.

sentences.zh: 從浦抵上海南倉浦口，百三十餘里，潮汐淤塞，已成平陸，氵豔沙遊泥，難以施工。

translations.literal: From the harbor to Nancang Harbor mouth at Shanghai, more than 130 li, tidal silt has blocked it and it has become level land; sediment sand and wandering mud make work difficult.
translations.idiomatic: From that harbor to Nancang Harbor at Shanghai—another 130-odd li—tidal silt has choked the channel until it is level ground, a mass of wandering mud and sand on which work can scarcely proceed.

sentences.zh: 嘉定劉家港即古婁江，徑入海，常熟白茆港徑入江，皆廣川急流。

translations.literal: Liujia Harbor in Jiading is the ancient Lou River, running straight to the sea; Ba Mao Harbor in Changshu runs straight into the river—both are broad streams with swift current.
translations.idiomatic: Liujia Harbor in Jiading is the ancient Lou River and runs straight to the sea; Ba Mao Harbor in Changshu runs straight into the Yangtze—both are broad, swift channels.

sentences.zh: 宜疏吳淞南北兩岸、安亭等浦，引太湖諸水入劉家、白茆二港，使其勢分。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dredge both north and south banks of the Wusong and harbors such as Anting, drawing the waters of Lake Tai into the two harbors of Liujia and Ba Mao to divide their force.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong's north and south banks and channels such as Anting should be dredged to divert Lake Tai's waters into Liujia and Ba Mao harbors and split the flow.

sentences.zh: 松江大黃浦乃通吳淞要道，今下流遏塞難浚。

translations.literal: The Great Huangpu in Songjiang is the main route to the Wusong, but now its lower reach is blocked and hard to dredge.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang's Great Huangpu is the main route to the Wusong, but its lower reach is now blocked and hard to dredge.

sentences.zh: 旁有範家浜，至南倉浦口徑達海。

translations.literal: Beside it is Fanjia Creek, which from Nancang Harbor mouth runs straight to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Beside it lies Fanjia Creek, which from Nancang Harbor runs straight to the sea.

sentences.zh: 宜浚深闊，上接大黃浦，達泖湖之水，庶幾復《禹貢》「三江入海「之舊。

translations.literal: It should be dredged deep and broad, connecting above with the Great Huangpu and reaching the waters of the Mo lakes, so that perhaps the old condition of the Yu Gong's 'Three Rivers entering the sea' may be restored.
translations.idiomatic: It should be dredged deep and wide, linked above to the Great Huangpu and below to the Mo lakes, so that the Yu Gong's old pattern of 'the Three Rivers entering the sea' might be restored.

sentences.zh: 水道既通，乃相地勢，各置石閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: Once the waterways are open, then according to terrain stone locks should be set at each place and opened and closed according to season.
translations.idiomatic: Once the waterways are open, stone locks should be set at suitable points and opened or closed according to the season.

sentences.zh: 每歲水涸時，預修圩岸，以防暴流，則水患可息。

translations.literal: Each year when the water runs low, polder banks should be repaired in advance against violent floods; then water disasters can cease.
translations.idiomatic: Each year, when the water runs low, the polder banks should be repaired in advance against sudden floods, and the flooding will abate.

sentences.zh: 」帝命發民丁開浚。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered laborers mobilized to open and dredge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered laborers mobilized for the dredging.

sentences.zh: 原吉晝夜徙步，以身先之，功遂成。

translations.literal: Yuanji day and night moved on foot, taking the lead in person, and the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji tramped the works day and night, leading in person, until the project was finished.

sentences.zh: 二年，修泰州河塘萬八千丈，興化南北堤、泰興沿江圩岸、六合瓜步等屯。

translations.literal: In the second year Taizhou river embankments were repaired for 18,000 zhang, Xinghua north and south dikes, Taixing riverfront polders, and Guabu and other garrisons in Luhe.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 2: 18,000 zhang of river embankments in Taizhou were repaired, along with the north and south dikes of Xinghua, Taixing's riverside polders, and the Guabu garrison lands in Luhe.

sentences.zh: 浚丹徒通潮舊江，又修象山茭湖塘岸，海康、徐聞二縣那隱坡、調黎等港堤岸，黃嚴混水等十五閘、六陡門，孟津河堤，分宜湖塘，武陟馬田堤岸，香山竹徑水陂，復興安分水塘。

translations.literal: The old tidal channel at Dantu was dredged; moreover the Jiaohu embankment at Xiangshan was repaired, the harbor dikes at Nayinpo and Diaoli in Haikang and Xuwen counties, fifteen locks including Hunshui in Huangyan and six stepped gates, the Mengjin River dike, the lake embankment at Fenyi, the Matian dike at Wuzhi, the Zhujing water dam at Xiangshan, and the Fen Shui embankment at Xing'an were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The old tidal channel at Dantu was dredged; embankments were also repaired at Jiaohu in Xiangshan, harbor dikes at Nayinpo and Diaoli in Haikang and Xuwen, fifteen locks including Hunshui in Huangyan and six stepped gates, the Mengjin River dike, Fenyi's lake embankment, Wuzhi's Matian dike, Xiangshan's Zhujing water dam, and Xing'an's Fen Shui embankment.

sentences.zh: 興安有江，源出海陽山。

translations.literal: At Xing'an there is a river whose source issues from Haiyang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At Xing'an a river rises on Haiyang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 江中橫築石埭，分南北渠，溉民田甚溥。

translations.literal: A stone weir was built across the river, dividing north and south channels, irrigating the people's fields very extensively.
translations.idiomatic: A stone weir built across the river divides north and south channels and waters a great expanse of farmland.

sentences.zh: 埭上疊石如鱗，以防沖溢。

translations.literal: On the weir stones were stacked like scales to guard against rushing overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Stones were laid on the weir like fish scales to withstand the rush of floodwater.

sentences.zh: 嚴震直撤石增埭，水迫無所泄，沖塘岸，盡趨北渠，南渠淺澀，民失利。

translations.literal: Yan Zhenzhi removed the stones and raised the weir; the water pressed with nowhere to discharge, rushed the pond banks, and all ran to the north channel; the south channel became shallow and sluggish, and the people lost benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenzhi had removed the stones and raised the weir; with nowhere for the water to spill, it battered the pond banks and poured entirely into the north channel, leaving the south channel shallow and sluggish and the people worse off.

sentences.zh: 至是修復如舊。

translations.literal: At this time it was repaired and restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: It was now restored to its former condition.

sentences.zh: 海門民請發淮安、蘇、常民丁協修張墩港、東明港百餘里潰堤。

translations.literal: The people of Haimen requested mobilizing laborers from Huai'an, Suzhou, and Changzhou to assist in repairing breached dikes of more than 100 li at Zhangdun Harbor and Dongming Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Haimen asked that laborers from Huai'an, Suzhou, and Changzhou be sent to help repair more than a hundred li of breached dikes at Zhangdun and Dongming harbors.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「三郡民方苦水患，不可重勞。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'The people of the three prefectures are just suffering from water disaster; they must not be doubly burdened.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'The people of those three prefectures are already suffering from flooding; they must not be burdened again.'

sentences.zh: 」遣官行視，以揚州民協築之。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to inspect on the spot, and Yangzhou laborers were used to assist in building.
translations.idiomatic: He sent officials to inspect the site and had Yangzhou laborers assist in the repairs.

sentences.zh: 當塗民言：「慈湖瀕江，上通宣、歙，東抵丹陽湖，西接蕪湖。

translations.literal: The people of Dangtu said: 'Cihu borders the river, upstream connecting Xuancheng and Shezhou, east reaching Danyang Lake, west joining Wuhu.'
translations.idiomatic: The people of Dangtu reported, 'Cihu lies on the river, linking upstream to Xuancheng and Shezhou, east to Danyang Lake, and west to Wuhu.'

sentences.zh: 久雨浸淫，潮漲傷農，宜遣勘修築。

translations.literal: Long rains have soaked the land, and rising tides harm farming; it is fitting to send men to survey and repair.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain has soaked the land, and rising tides have harmed the crops; officials should be sent to survey and repair the works.

sentences.zh: 」帝從其請，且諭工部，安、徽、蘇、鬆，浙江、江西、湖廣，凡湖泊卑下，圩岸傾頹，亟督有司治之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted their request, and moreover instructed the Ministry of Works that in Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang, wherever lakes were low-lying and polder banks collapsed, the local officials should be urgently directed to repair them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request and also told the Ministry of Works to press officials in Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang to repair at once every low-lying lake and collapsed polder bank.

sentences.zh: 夏原吉復奉命治水蘇、鬆，盡通舊河港。

translations.literal: Xia Yuanji again received orders to manage water in Suzhou and Songjiang, fully opening the old river harbors.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yuanji was again ordered to manage the waters of Suzhou and Songjiang and fully reopen the old channels.

sentences.zh: 又浚蘇州千墩浦、致和塘、安亭、顧浦、陸皎浦、尤涇、黃涇共二萬九千餘丈，松江大黃浦、赤雁浦、範家浜共萬二千丈，以通太湖下流。

translations.literal: Moreover Qiandun Harbor, Zhihe Pond, Anting, Gupu, Lujiaopu, Youjing, and Huangjing in Suzhou were dredged for a total of more than 29,000 zhang; the Great Huangpu, Chiyan Harbor, and Fanjia Creek in Songjiang for a total of 12,000 zhang—to open the lower outflow of Lake Tai.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged more than 29,000 zhang at Qiandun Harbor, Zhihe Pond, Anting, Gupu, Lujiaopu, Youjing, and Huangjing in Suzhou, and 12,000 zhang at the Great Huangpu, Chiyan Harbor, and Fanjia Creek in Songjiang, to restore Lake Tai's lower outflow.

sentences.zh: 先是，修含山崇義堰。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Chongyi Dam at Hanshan had been repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Chongyi Dam at Hanshan had been repaired.

sentences.zh: 未幾，和州民言：「銅城閘上抵巢湖，下揚子江，決圩岸七十餘處，乞修治。

translations.literal: Before long the people of He Prefecture said: 'The Tongcheng sluice reaches Chaohu Lake upstream and the Yangtze downstream; polder banks have breached in more than seventy places—we beg repair.'
translations.idiomatic: Before long the people of He Prefecture reported, 'The Tongcheng sluice reaches Chaohu upstream and the Yangtze downstream; polder banks have breached in more than seventy places—we ask that they be repaired.'

sentences.zh: 」其吏目張良興又言：「水淹麻、澧二湖田五萬餘頃，宜築圩埂，起桃花橋，訖含山界三十里。

translations.literal: Its clerical officer Zhang Liangxing also said: 'Water has flooded fields of the Ma and Li lakes totaling more than 50,000 qing; it is fitting to build polder embankments from Taohua Bridge to the Hanshan border for thirty li.'
translations.idiomatic: Its clerical officer Zhang Liangxing added, 'Floodwaters have submerged more than 50,000 qing of fields on the Ma and Li lakes; polder embankments should be built from Taohua Bridge to the Hanshan border for thirty li.'

sentences.zh: 」俱從之。

translations.literal: Both were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 三年，修上虞曹娥江壩埂，溫縣馱塢村堤堰四千餘丈，南海衛蓮塘、四會縣鴉鵲水等堤岸，無為州周興等鄉及鷹揚衛烏江屯江岸。

translations.literal: In the third year the dam embankment on the Cao'e River at Shangyu was repaired; dikes and dams at Tuowu Village in Wen County for more than 4,000 zhang; dikes at Liantang in Nanhai Guard and Yaque Water in Sihui County; and river banks at Zhouxing and other townships in Wuwei Prefecture and the Wujiang garrison of Yingyang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 3: the Cao'e River dam at Shangyu was repaired; more than 4,000 zhang of dikes at Tuowu Village in Wen County; dikes at Liantang in Nanhai Guard and Yaque Water in Sihui; and river banks at Zhouxing township in Wuwei and the Wujiang garrison of Yingyang Guard.

sentences.zh: 築昌黎及曆城小清河決堤，應天新河口北岸，從大勝關抵江東驛三千三百丈。

translations.literal: Breached dikes on the Xiaoqing River at Changli and Licheng were built up; the north bank at Xinkouhe in Yingtian, from Dasheng Pass to Jiangdong Post for 3,300 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes on the Xiaoqing River at Changli and Licheng were repaired; 3,300 zhang of north bank at Xinkouhe in Yingtian, from Dasheng Pass to Jiangdong Post.

sentences.zh: 浚海州北舊河，上通高橋，下接臨洪場及山陽運鹽河十八里。

translations.literal: The old river north of Haizhou was dredged, connecting above with Gaoqiao and below with Linhong Station and the Shanyang salt transport river for eighteen li.
translations.idiomatic: The old river north of Haizhou was dredged, linking Gaoqiao upstream to Linhong Station and eighteen li of the Shanyang salt transport river downstream.

sentences.zh: 四年，修築宣城十九圩，豐城穆湖圩岸，石首臨江萬石堤，溧水決圩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the nineteen polders of Xuancheng were built and repaired, the Mu Lake polder bank at Fengcheng, the Wanshi dike facing the river at Shishou, and breached polders at Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 4: the nineteen polders of Xuancheng were repaired, the Mu Lake polder at Fengcheng, the Wanshi riverside dike at Shishou, and breached polders at Lishui.

sentences.zh: 修懷寧鬥潭河、彭灘圩岸，順天固安，保定荊岱，樂亭魯家套、社河口，吉水劉家塘、雲陂，江都劉家圩港。

translations.literal: Dou Pond River and Pengtan polder bank at Huaining were repaired; Gu'an in Shuntian; Jingdai in Baoding; Lujiatuo and Shehekou in Leting; Liujiatang and Yunpo in Jishui; and Liujia polder harbor in Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Pond River and the Pengtan polder at Huaining were repaired, along with Gu'an in Shuntian, Jingdai in Baoding, Lujiatuo and Shehekou in Leting, Liujiatang and Yunpo in Jishui, and Liujia polder harbor in Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 築湖廣廣濟、武家穴等江岸。

translations.literal: River banks at Guangji and Wujiaxue in Huguang were built.
translations.idiomatic: River banks at Guangji and Wujiaxue in Huguang were built up.

sentences.zh: 新建石頭岡圩岸、江浦沿江堤。

translations.literal: New polder banks at Shitougang and the riverside dike at Jiangpu were built.
translations.idiomatic: New polder banks at Shitougang and the riverside dike at Jiangpu were constructed.

sentences.zh: 開泰州運鹽河、普定秦潼河、西溪南儀阡三處河口，導流興化、鹽城界入海。

translations.literal: The Taizhou salt transport river was opened, and the mouths of the Qintong River at Puding, and Nan Yiqian at Xixi in three places, directing flow from the Xinghua and Yancheng border into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizhou salt transport river was opened, and the mouths of the Qintong River at Puding and Nan Yiqian at Xixi—three outlets in all—to carry water from the Xinghua–Yancheng border to the sea.

sentences.zh: 浚常熟福山塘三十六里。

translations.literal: Fushan Pond at Changshu was dredged for thirty-six li.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan Pond at Changshu was dredged for thirty-six li.

sentences.zh: 五年，修長洲、吳江、崑山、華亭、錢塘、仁和、嘉興堤岸，餘姚南湖壩，築高要銀岡、金山等潰堤，溉田五百餘頃。

translations.literal: In the fifth year dikes at Changzhou, Wujiang, Kunshan, Huating, Qiantang, Renhe, and Jiaxing were repaired; the south lake dam at Yuyao; breached dikes at Yingang and Jinshan in Gaoyao were built up, irrigating more than 500 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 5: dikes at Changzhou, Wujiang, Kunshan, Huating, Qiantang, Renhe, and Jiaxing were repaired; the south lake dam at Yuyao; breached dikes at Yingang and Jinshan in Gaoyao were built up, watering more than 500 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 治杭州江岸之淪者。

translations.literal: The collapsed stretches of Hangzhou's river bank were treated.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed stretches of Hangzhou's river bank were repaired.

sentences.zh: 六年浚浙江平陽縣河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the river in Pingyang County, Zhejiang, was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 6: the river in Pingyang County, Zhejiang, was dredged.

sentences.zh: 七年修安陸州渲馬灘決岸、海鹽石堤，築泰興攔江堤三千九百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the breached bank at Xuanma Beach in Anlu Prefecture and the stone dike at Haiyan were repaired; the river-blocking dike at Taixing was built for more than 3,900 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 7: the breached bank at Xuanma Beach in Anlu and the stone dike at Haiyan were repaired; a river-blocking dike of more than 3,900 zhang was built at Taixing.

sentences.zh: 且浚大港北淤河，抵縣南，出大江，四千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: Moreover the silted north branch of Dagang was dredged to the south of the county and out to the great river for more than 4,500 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The silted north branch of Dagang was also dredged south of the county to the great river for more than 4,500 zhang.

sentences.zh: 八年修丹陽練湖塘，汝陽汝河堤岸，南陵野塘圩、蚌蕩壩，鬆滋張家坑、何家洲堤岸，平度州濰水、浮糠河決口百十二，堤堰八千餘丈，吳江石塘官路橋樑。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Lianhu Pond at Danyang was repaired; the Ru River bank at Ruyang; the Yetang polder and Bangdang Dam at Nanling; dikes at Zhangjiakeng and Hejiazhou in Songzi; 112 breaches on the Weishui and Fukang River at Pingdu Prefecture and dikes and dams for more than 8,000 zhang; and the stone-paved official road bridges at Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 8: Lianhu Pond at Danyang, the Ru River bank at Ruyang, the Yetang polder and Bangdang Dam at Nanling, dikes at Zhangjiakeng and Hejiazhou in Songzi, 112 breaches on the Weishui and Fukang rivers at Pingdu and more than 8,000 zhang of dikes and dams, and the stone-paved official road bridges at Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 九年，修安福丁陂等塘堰，安仁鐃家陂、壽光堤，安陸京山景陵圩岸，長樂官塘，長洲至嘉興石土塘橋路七十餘里，泄水洞百三十一處，監利車水堤四千四百餘丈，高安華陂屯陂堤，仁和、海寧、海鹽土石塘岸萬餘丈。

translations.literal: In the ninth year ponds and dams such as Dingpi at Anfu were repaired; Raojia Dam at Anren and the dike at Shouguang; polder banks at Jingshan and Jingling in Anlu; the official pond at Changle; stone and earth embankment roads and bridges from Changzhou to Jiaxing for more than seventy li; 131 drainage culverts; the water-lifting dike at Jianli for more than 4,400 zhang; the Huapi garrison dam at Gao'an; and earthen and stone embankments at Renhe, Haining, and Haiyan for more than 10,000 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 9: ponds and dams including Dingpi at Anfu, Raojia Dam at Anren, and the Shouguang dike; polder banks at Jingshan and Jingling in Anlu; the official pond at Changle; more than seventy li of stone and earth roads and bridges from Changzhou to Jiaxing; 131 drainage culverts; more than 4,400 zhang of water-lifting dikes at Jianli; the Huapi garrison dam at Gao'an; and more than 10,000 zhang of earthen and stone embankments at Renhe, Haining, and Haiyan.

sentences.zh: 築沂州沭河口決岸，並瀹述陽述河。

translations.literal: The breached bank at the mouth of the Shu River in Yizhou was built up, and the Shuyang River was also dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The breached bank at the Shu River mouth in Yizhou was repaired, and the Shuyang River was dredged as well.

sentences.zh: 築直隸新城張村等口決堤，仁和黃濠塘岸三百餘丈，孫家圍塘岸二十餘里。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Zhangcun and other openings in Xincheng, Zhili, were built up; the Huanghao embankment at Renhe for more than 300 zhang; and the Sunjiawei embankment for more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Zhangcun and other openings in Xincheng, Zhili, were repaired; more than 300 zhang of Huanghao embankment at Renhe; and more than twenty li of Sunjiawei embankment.

sentences.zh: 浚濰縣幹丹河、定襄故渠六十三里，引滹沱水灌田六百餘頃。

translations.literal: Gandan River in Wei County and the old channel at Dingxiang for sixty-three li were dredged, drawing Hutuo River water to irrigate more than 600 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Gandan River in Wei County and sixty-three li of the old channel at Dingxiang were dredged to bring Hutuo water to more than 600 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 疏福山官渠，浚江陰青陽河道，鄒平白條溝河三十餘里。

translations.literal: The official canal at Fushan was cleared; the Qingyang River channel at Jiangyin was dredged; and the Baitiao Ditch River at Zouping for more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: The official canal at Fushan was cleared, the Qingyang River channel at Jiangyin was dredged, and more than thirty li of the Baitiao Ditch River at Zouping.

sentences.zh: 麗水民言：「縣有通濟渠，截鬆陽、遂昌諸溪水入焉。

translations.literal: The people of Lishui said: "The county has the Tongji Canal, which diverts the stream-waters of Songyang, Suichang, and other counties into it.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Lishui reported, "The county has the Tongji Canal, which channels the waters of Songyang, Suichang, and neighboring streams into it.

sentences.zh: 上、中、下三源，流四十八派，溉田二千餘頃。

translations.literal: It has upper, middle, and lower three sources, flows in forty-eight branches, and irrigates more than two thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: With upper, middle, and lower sources, it runs in forty-eight branches and irrigates more than two thousand qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 上源民泄水自利，下源流絕，沙壅渠塞。

translations.literal: The people of the upper source discharge water for their own benefit; the lower source's flow is cut off, and sand blocks the channel.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream communities release water for their own gain, leaving the lower reaches dry while sand chokes the canal.

sentences.zh: 請修堤堰如舊。

translations.literal: We beg that dikes and dams be repaired as before.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the dikes and dams be restored to their former state.

sentences.zh: 」部議從之。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated and agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry reviewed the proposal and approved it.

sentences.zh: 齊東知縣張升言：「小清河洪水沖決，淹沒諸鹽場及青州田。

translations.literal: Zhang Sheng, magistrate of Qidong, said: "Floods on the Xiaoqing River have burst through and inundated the salt works and fields in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Sheng, magistrate of Qidong, reported, "Xiaoqing River floods have broken through and flooded the salt fields and cropland in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 請浚上流，修長堤，使水行故道。

translations.literal: We beg to dredge the upper reaches, repair the long dike, and restore the water to its former course.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the upper reaches be dredged and the long dike repaired so the river may follow its old channel.

sentences.zh: 」皇太子遣官經理之。

translations.literal: " The crown prince sent officials to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince dispatched officials to take charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 鄜州民言：「洛水橫決而西，沖塌州城東北隅。

translations.literal: The people of Fuzhou said: "The Luo River burst across to the west and washed away the northeastern corner of the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fuzhou reported, "The Luo River broke westward and collapsed the northeastern corner of the prefectural wall.

sentences.zh: 請浚故道，循州東山麓南流。

translations.literal: We beg to dredge the old channel so that it flows south along the eastern foothills of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the old course be dredged so the river may run south along the eastern foothills of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，修浙江平陽捍潮堤岸，黃梅臨江決岸百二十餘里，海門捍潮堤百三十里。

translations.literal: In the tenth year tide-control embankments at Pingyang in Zhejiang were repaired; breached river banks at Huangmei along the river for more than 120 li; and tide-control dikes at Haimen for 130 li.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 10: tide embankments at Pingyang, Zhejiang, were repaired; more than 120 li of breached river bank at Huangmei; and 130 li of tide dikes at Haimen.

sentences.zh: 築新會圩岸二千餘丈，獻縣、饒陽恭儉等岸，安丘紅河決岸，安州直亭等河決口八十九，華容、安津等堤決口四十六。

translations.literal: Polder banks at Xinhui were built up for more than two thousand zhang; banks at Gongjian and elsewhere in Xian and Raoyang counties; the breached bank of the Hong River at Anqiu; eighty-nine breaches on rivers such as Zhiting at Anzhou; and forty-six dike breaches at Huarong, Anjin, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 10: more than two thousand zhang of polder bank at Xinhui; Gongjian and other banks in Xian and Raoyang; the Hong River breach at Anqiu; eighty-nine river breaks including Zhiting at Anzhou; and forty-six dike breaks at Huarong, Anjin, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 浚上海蟠龍江、濰縣白浪河。

translations.literal: Panlong River in Shanghai and the Bailang River in Wei County were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong River in Shanghai and the Bailang River in Wei County were dredged.

sentences.zh: 北京行太僕卿楊砥言：「吳橋、東光、興濟、交河及天津等衛屯田，雨水決堤傷稼。

translations.literal: Yang Di, Director of the Beijing Branch of the Court of the Imperial Stud, said: "Garrison farmlands at Wuqiao, Dongguang, Xingji, Jiaohe, Tianjin, and other guards have had dikes breached by rainwater, damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Di, Director of the Beijing Branch of the Court of the Imperial Stud, reported, "Rain has breached dikes on garrison farms at Wuqiao, Dongguang, Xingji, Jiaohe, Tianjin, and other guards, ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 德州良店驛東南二十五里有黃河故道，與州南土河通。

translations.literal: Twenty-five li southeast of Liangdian Post in Dezhou there is an old course of the Yellow River that connects with the earthen river south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five li southeast of Liangdian Post in Dezhou lies an old Yellow River channel that joins the earthen river south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 穿渠置閘，分殺水勢，大為民便。

translations.literal: Cutting a canal and setting sluice-gates to divide and reduce the water's force would greatly benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting a canal and installing sluice-gates to split and tame the flood would greatly ease conditions for the people.

sentences.zh: 」命侍郎蘭芳往理之。

translations.literal: " Vice Minister Lan Fang was ordered to go and manage it.
translations.idiomatic: " Vice Minister Lan Fang was ordered to take charge of the project.

sentences.zh: 十一年，修蕪湖陶辛、政和二圩，保定、文安二縣河口決岸五十四，應天新河圩岸，天長福勝、戚家莊二塘，滎澤大濱河堤。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Taoxin and Zhenghe No. 2 polders at Wuhu were repaired; fifty-four breached river mouths in Baoding and Wen'an counties; the Xinghe polder bank in Yingtian; the Fusheng and Qijiazhuang ponds at Tianchang; and the dike on the Dabin River at Xingze.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 11: the Taoxin and Zhenghe No. 2 polders at Wuhu; fifty-four river-mouth breaches in Baoding and Wen'an; the Xinghe polder bank in Yingtian; the Fusheng and Qijiazhuang ponds at Tianchang; and the Dabin River dike at Xingze.

sentences.zh: 浚崑山太平河。

translations.literal: Taiping River in Kunshan was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping River in Kunshan was dredged.

sentences.zh: 十二年修鳳陽安豐塘水門十六座及牛角壩、新倉鋪塌岸，武陟郭村、馬曲堤岸，聊城龍灣河，濮州紅船口，範縣曹村河堤岸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year sixteen sluice-gates of Anfeng Pond at Fengyang were repaired, along with the Niujiao Dam and the collapsed bank at Xincangpu; dikes at Guocun and Maqu in Wuzhi; Longwan River in Liaocheng; Hongchuankou in Puzhou; and the Cao Village River bank at Fan County.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 12: sixteen sluice-gates of Anfeng Pond at Fengyang, the Niujiao Dam, and the collapsed bank at Xincangpu; dikes at Guocun and Maqu in Wuzhi; Longwan River in Liaocheng; Hongchuankou in Puzhou; and the Cao Village River embankment at Fan County.

sentences.zh: 築三河決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes on the Sanhe were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes on the Sanhe were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚海州官河二百四十里。

translations.literal: The official canal in Haizhou was dredged for 240 li.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty li of the official canal in Haizhou were dredged.

sentences.zh: 解州民言：「臨晉涑水河逆流，決姚暹渠堰，入砂地，淹民田，將及鹽池。

translations.literal: The people of Xiezhou said: "The Sushui River at Linjin is flowing backward, has burst the Yaoqian Canal dam, entered sandy ground, flooded civilian fields, and is about to reach the salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xiezhou reported, "At Linjin the Sushui River is running backward, has broken the Yaoqian Canal dam, spread into sandy flats, flooded farmland, and threatens the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 」尋又言：「硝池水溢，決豁口，入鹽池。

translations.literal: " Shortly afterward they again said: "The Xiaochi Pond has overflowed, burst its opening, and entered the salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon after they added, "Xiaochi Pond has overflowed, broken through its outlet, and poured into the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 」以涑水渠、姚暹渠並流，故命官修築如其請。

translations.literal: " Because the Sushui Canal and Yaoqian Canal were flowing together, officials were ordered to repair and build as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " Because the Sushui and Yaoqian canals were running together, officials were ordered to carry out repairs as petitioned.

sentences.zh: 十三年，修興濟決岸、南京羽林右衛刁家圩屯田堤。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the breached bank at Xingji and the Dijia polder garrison-farm dike of the Right Wing of the Yulin Guard in Nanjing were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 13: the breach at Xingji and the Dijia polder garrison-farm dike of the Right Wing of the Yulin Guard in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 吳江縣丞李升言：「蘇、鬆水患，太湖為甚，急宜泄其下流。

translations.literal: Li Sheng, assistant magistrate of Wujiang, said: "Suzhou and Songjiang suffer from water disasters, of which Lake Tai is the worst; its lower outlet should urgently be released.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng, assistant magistrate of Wujiang, reported, "Suzhou and Songjiang are plagued by flooding, worst of all from Lake Tai; its lower outlet must be opened at once.

sentences.zh: 若常熟白茆諸港，崑山千墩等河，長洲十八都港汊，吳縣、無錫近湖河道，皆宜循其故跡，浚而深之。

translations.literal: Such places as the Baimao harbors at Changshu, the Qiandun and other rivers at Kunshan, the channel mouths of the Eighteen Districts at Changzhou, and the lake-side waterways of Wu and Wuxi counties should all follow their old traces and be dredged deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Ports such as Baimao at Changshu, rivers such as Qiandun at Kunshan, the channel mouths of the Eighteen Districts at Changzhou, and the lake-side waterways of Wu and Wuxi should all be cleared along their former courses and dug deeper.

sentences.zh: 乃修蔡涇等閘，候潮來往，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: Then sluices such as Caijing should be repaired, awaiting the tide's coming and going and opened and closed at the proper times.
translations.idiomatic: Sluices such as Caijing should also be restored, timed to the tide so they may open and close as needed.

sentences.zh: 則氾濫可免，而民獲耕種之利。

translations.literal: Then flooding can be avoided and the people will obtain the benefit of cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Thus flooding may be checked and the people regain land for planting.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十五年修固安孫家口及臨漳固塚堤岸。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the river mouths at Sunjiakou in Gu'an and the Guzhong bank at Linzhang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 15: the Sunjiakou river mouths in Gu'an and the Guzhong bank at Linzhang.

sentences.zh: 十六年，修魏縣決岸。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the breached bank at Wei County was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 16: the breach at Wei County was repaired.

sentences.zh: 十七年，蕭山民言：「境內河渠四十五里，溉田萬頃，比年淤塞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the people of Xiaoshan said: "Within the prefecture are canals and channels of forty-five li that irrigate ten thousand qing of fields; in recent years they have silted shut.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 17: the people of Xiaoshan reported, "The prefecture has forty-five li of canals and channels irrigating ten thousand qing of fields, but in recent years they have silted up.

sentences.zh: 乞疏浚，仍置閘錢清小江壩東，庶旱潦無憂。

translations.literal: We beg dredging and clearing, and also setting a sluice east of the Qianqing Xiaojiang dam, so that drought and flood need not be feared.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that they be dredged and a sluice set east of the Qianqing Xiaojiang dam so drought and flood may no longer threaten us.

sentences.zh: 」山東新城民言：「縣東鄭黃溝源出淄川，下流壅沮，霖潦妨農。

translations.literal: " The people of Xincheng in Shandong said: "Zhenghuang Ditch east of the county rises in Zichuan; its lower course is blocked and choked, and seasonal rains hinder farming.
translations.idiomatic: " The people of Xincheng, Shandong, reported, "Zhenghuang Ditch east of the county rises in Zichuan; its lower course is choked, and heavy rains now ruin the crops.

sentences.zh: 陳家莊南有乾河，上與溝接，下通烏江，乞浚治。

translations.literal: South of Chenjiazhuang there is a dry river that joins the ditch above and reaches the Wujiang below; we beg dredging and repair.
translations.idiomatic: South of Chenjiazhuang a dry channel links the ditch above to the Wujiang below; we ask that it be dredged and restored.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Both petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，海甯諸縣民言：「潮沒海塘二千六百餘丈，延及吳家等壩。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the people of the Haining counties said: "The tide has submerged more than 2,600 zhang of seawall and extended to dams such as Wujia.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 18: the people of the Haining counties reported, "Tides have overrun more than 2,600 zhang of seawall and reached dams such as Wujia.

sentences.zh: 」通政嶽福亦言：「仁和、海寧壞長降等壩，淪海千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: " Yue Fu, Director of the Office of Transmission, also said: "Dams such as Changjiang at Renhe and Haining have collapsed, and more than 1,500 zhang of land has been lost to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: " Director of the Office of Transmission Yue Fu also reported, "Dams such as Changjiang at Renhe and Haining have failed, and more than 1,500 zhang of coast have been swallowed by the sea.

sentences.zh: 東岸赭山、嚴門山、蜀山舊有海道，淤絕久，故西岸潮愈猛。

translations.literal: On the eastern shore, Zheshan, Yanmen Mountain, and Shushan once had seaways, but long silted shut; therefore the tide on the western shore grows fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: East of Zheshan, Yanmen Mountain, and Shushan there were once sea channels, now long filled in, so the western shore faces ever fiercer tides.

sentences.zh: 乞以軍民修築。

translations.literal: We beg that soldiers and civilians be sent to repair and build.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that troops and civilians be mobilized for repairs.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 明年修海寧等縣塘岸。

translations.literal: The next year the seawall banks at Haining and other counties were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The following year seawall banks at Haining and other counties were repaired.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，修嘉定抵松江潮圮圩岸五千餘丈、交恥順化衛決堤百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year more than 5,000 zhang of tide-collapsed polder banks from Jiading to Songjiang were repaired, and more than 100 zhang of breached dike at Shunhua Guard in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 21: more than 5,000 zhang of tide-broken polder banks from Jiading to Songjiang, and more than 100 zhang of dike breach at Shunhua Guard in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 文水民言：「文谷山常稔渠分引文穀河流，袤三十餘里，灌田。

translations.literal: The people of Wenshui said: "The Changren Canal on Wengu Mountain diverts the Wengu River, extending more than thirty li and irrigating fields.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Wenshui reported, "The Changren Canal on Wengu Mountain draws off the Wengu River for more than thirty li to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 今河潰泄水。

sentences.zh: 」從其奏，葺治之。

translations.literal: " Their memorial was approved and repairs were carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " Their petition was approved and repairs were undertaken.

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the sluice on the Guangji River at Linhai was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 22: the sluice on the Guangji River at Linhai was repaired.

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi the coastal sluice-dams at Huangyan were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1: the coastal sluice-dams at Huangyan were repaired.

sentences.zh: 視永樂初，增府判一員，專其事。

translations.literal: Compared with early Yongle, one additional prefectural judge was added to specialize in the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with early Yongle, one additional prefectural judge was appointed to oversee the work exclusively.

sentences.zh: 修獻縣、鐃陽恭儉堤及窯堤口。

translations.literal: The Gongjian dike and Yaodi mouth in Xian and Raoyang counties were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Gongjian dike and Yaodi mouth in Xian and Raoyang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年，浙江歸安知縣華嵩言：「涇陽洪渠堰溉五縣田八千四百餘頃。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande Hua Song, magistrate of Gui'an in Zhejiang, said: "The Hongqu Canal dam at Jingyang irrigates fields in five counties totaling more than 8,400 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 2: Hua Song, magistrate of Gui'an in Zhejiang, reported, "The Hongqu Canal dam at Jingyang waters more than 8,400 qing of fields across five counties.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，長興侯耿炳文前後修浚，未久堰壞。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu period the Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen dredged and repaired it before and after, but before long the dam collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongwu the Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen dredged and repaired it repeatedly, yet the dam soon failed again.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，老人徐齡言於朝，遣官修築，會營造不果。

translations.literal: During Yongle the elder Xu Ling spoke to the court, and officials were sent to repair and build, but construction projects prevented completion.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle the elder Xu Ling appealed to the court and officials were dispatched to rebuild, but palace construction left the work unfinished.

translations.literal: We beg that a senior minister be specially ordered to raise corvée laborers for joint management.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a senior minister be charged to mobilize laborers for a coordinated effort.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年修灌縣都江等堰四十四。

translations.literal: In the third year forty-four weirs such as the Dujiangyan works at Guan County were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 3: forty-four weirs including the Dujiangyan works at Guan County were repaired.

sentences.zh: 臨海民言：「胡巉諸閘瀦水灌田，近年閘壞而金鰲、大浦、湖淶、舉嶼等河遂皆壅阻，乞為開築。

translations.literal: The people of Linhai said: "The Huyan and other sluices impound water to irrigate fields; in recent years the sluices have broken, and rivers such as Jin'ao, Dapu, Hulu, and Juyu have all become blocked—we beg that they be opened and built.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Linhai reported, "The Huyan and other sluices store water for irrigation; lately the sluices have failed, and the Jin'ao, Dapu, Hulu, and Juyu rivers are all choked—we ask that they be cleared and rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「水利急務，使民自訴於朝，此守令不得人爾。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Water conservancy is an urgent task; when the people must plead at court themselves, this shows that the local officials are not the right men.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Water works are urgent; when commoners must appeal to the throne themselves, the prefects and magistrates are plainly unfit for their posts.

sentences.zh: 」命工部即飭郡縣秋收起工。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Works was ordered at once to instruct the prefectures and counties to begin work after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry of Works was ordered immediately to command the prefectures and counties to start work after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 仍詔天下：「凡水利當興者，有司即舉行，毋緩視。」

translations.literal: An edict was also issued throughout the empire: "Wherever water conservancy ought to be undertaken, the responsible offices shall proceed at once and must not treat it lightly."
translations.idiomatic: An edict also went out to the realm: "Wherever water works should be undertaken, local offices must act at once and must not delay."

sentences.zh: 巡按江西御史許勝言：「南昌瑞河兩岸低窪，多良田。

translations.literal: Xu Sheng, touring censor of Jiangxi, said: "Both banks of the Rui River at Nanchang are low-lying and hold much fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Sheng, touring censor of Jiangxi, reported, "Both banks of the Rui River at Nanchang are low and hold rich farmland.

sentences.zh: 洪武間修築，水不為患。

translations.literal: They were built up in the Hongwu period, and water did not become a calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongwu they were fortified, and the river did not threaten disaster.

sentences.zh: 比年水溢，岸圮二十餘處。

translations.literal: In recent years the water has overflowed and banks have collapsed in more than twenty places.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the river has risen and more than twenty stretches of bank have given way.

sentences.zh: 豐城安沙繩灣圩岸三千六百餘丈，永樂間水沖，改修百三十餘丈。

translations.literal: The Ansha Shengwan polder bank at Fengcheng is more than 3,600 zhang; during Yongle floodwater washed it away and it was rebuilt for more than 130 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The Ansha Shengwan polder at Fengcheng runs more than 3,600 zhang; in Yongle floods tore it apart and only some 130 zhang were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 近者久雨，江漲堤壞。

translations.literal: Recently, after long rains, the river rose and the dike was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged rain the river has again risen and the dike has failed.

sentences.zh: 乞敕有司募夫修理。

translations.literal: We beg that the responsible offices be ordered to recruit laborers for repair.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that officials be ordered to hire labor for repairs.

sentences.zh: 」中書舍人陸伯倫言：「常熟七浦塘東西百里，灌常熟、崑山田，歲租二十餘萬石。

translations.literal: " Lu Bolun, Secretariat Drafter, said: "The Qipu Pond east and west for a hundred li waters fields in Changshu and Kunshan, with annual grain tax of more than 200,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: " Secretariat Drafter Lu Bolun reported, "Qipu Pond stretches east and west for a hundred li, watering fields in Changshu and Kunshan that yield more than 200,000 shi in annual tax grain.

sentences.zh: 乞聽民自浚之。

translations.literal: We beg that the people be allowed to dredge it themselves.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the people be permitted to dredge it on their own.

sentences.zh: 」皆詔可。

translations.literal: " All were approved by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: " All petitions received imperial approval.

translations.literal: In the fourth year the dike bank at Liulin Mouth in Xian County was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 4: the dike bank at Liulin Mouth in Xian County.

translations.idiomatic: The people of Qianjiang reported, "Banghu and Yanghu lie on the Xiang River; rising water breaks the banks and ruins garrison farms of the three Jingzhou guards and countless official and private fields in Jingmen, Jiangling, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 乞發軍民築治。

translations.idiomatic: We ask that troops and civilians be mobilized for construction and repair.

translations.idiomatic: The people of Fuqing reported, "More than a hundred qing of official and private fields in Guangxian Li rely on a seawall.

translations.literal: The dike has long been broken and the fields are wholly abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: The dike has long failed and the land lies wholly fallow.

translations.literal: During Yongle repair was once ordered, but to this day it has not been undertaken and the people cannot farm.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle repairs were ordered, yet nothing has been done since and the people cannot cultivate.

translations.idiomatic: " The emperor rebuked the officials to repair it at once and told Minister Wu Zhong to warn prefectures and counties that ponds, pools, dikes, and dams must be maintained promptly, with negligence punished.

translations.idiomatic: Xuande 5: Grand Coordinator Cheng Jun reported, "The salt fields stand two li from the sea; more than 2,400 zhang of stone-faced earthen bank have been undercut until the stonework is ruined.

translations.idiomatic: The plan is to set new stonework inside the bank while leaving the old facing as an outer shield.

translations.idiomatic: We ask that, as in Hongwu, Jiaxing, Yanzhou, and Shaoxing be ordered to furnish labor together.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6: dikes and dams in Liuyang, Guangji, and other counties; the northwestern riverside stone dike and seven southwestern polder dams at Fengcheng; and three river dikes at Shishou.

translations.literal: The old river pool in Yuyao was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The old river pool in Yuyao was dredged.

translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen reported, "The Yongfeng polder in Lishui, over eighty li around, is encircled by Danyang, Shijiu, and other lakes.

translations.idiomatic: Embankments once linked it through the Shengmen Stone Pagoda and made farming highly productive.

sentences.zh: 今頹敗，請葺治。

translations.literal: Now they have collapsed; we beg repair.
translations.idiomatic: They have now fallen in; we ask that they be restored.

translations.idiomatic: Under Hongwu it was dredged to water fields.

translations.idiomatic: It is now choked; we ask that it be cleared and reopened.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Both petitions were approved.

translations.idiomatic: Its waters rise from Peng Mountain, split into sixteen canals, and irrigate more than 25,000 mu.
