sentences.zh: 浪益急，遂潰南岸，沒民田三十餘里，鹽池護堤皆壞。

translations.literal: The waves grew fiercer still, burst the south bank, submerged civilian fields for more than thirty li, and destroyed all the protective dikes of the salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: Surging floods then broke the south bank, drowned more than thirty li of farmland, and ruined every protective dike around the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 復因下流涑水河高，壅淤逆流，姚暹以決。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the Sushui River downstream is high, silt backs up and flows backward, and Yaoqian has burst.
translations.idiomatic: Because the lower Sushui River stands higher, silt has backed up and reversed the current, breaking Yaoqian anew.

sentences.zh: 乞起民夫疏瀹。

translations.literal: We beg that corvée laborers be raised for dredging and clearing.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that laborers be mobilized for dredging and repair.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 蘇州知府況鐘言：「蘇、鬆、嘉、湖湖有六，曰太湖、龐山、陽城、沙湖、昆承、尚湖。

translations.literal: The prefect of Suzhou, Kuang Zhong, said: "Among Suzhou, Song, Jia, and Hu there are six lakes, namely Taihu, Pangshan, Yangcheng, Shahu, Kun-Cheng, and Shanghu.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou Prefect Kuang Zhong reported, "In Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou there are six lakes—Taihu, Pangshan, Yangcheng, Shahu, Kun-Cheng, and Shanghu.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，夏原吉浚導，今復淤。

translations.literal: Early in Yongle, Xia Yuanji dredged and channeled them; now they are silted again.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign Xia Yuanji dredged and opened them; they have silted up again.

sentences.zh: 乞遣大臣疏浚。

translations.literal: We beg that a senior minister be sent to dredge them.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a senior minister be dispatched to dredge them.

sentences.zh: 」乃命周忱與鐘治之。

translations.literal: " The court then ordered Zhou Chen and Kuang Zhong to oversee the work.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then ordered Zhou Chen and Kuang Zhong to take charge of the project.

sentences.zh: 是歲，汾河驟溢，敗太原堤。

translations.literal: That year the Fen River suddenly overflowed and broke the Taiyuan dikes.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Fen River burst its banks and destroyed the Taiyuan dikes.

sentences.zh: 鎮守都司李謙、巡按御史徐傑以便宜修治，然後馳奏。

translations.literal: Li Qian, regional commander of the guard, and investigating censor Xu Jie repaired on expedient authority and then sent an urgent memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Li Qian and Investigating Censor Xu Jie repaired the damage on their own authority and then submitted an urgent memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended them.

sentences.zh: 八年，葺湖廣偏橋衛高陂石洞，完縣南關舊河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Gaopo stone culvert at Pianqiao Guard in Huguang was repaired and the old river at the county's south pass was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8: the Gaopo stone culvert at Pianqiao Guard in Huguang was restored and the old river at the county south pass was completed.

sentences.zh: 復和州銅城堰閘。

translations.literal: The Tongcheng Weir sluice at Hezhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongcheng Weir sluice at Hezhou was restored.

sentences.zh: 修安陽廣惠等渠，磁州滏陽河、五爪濟民渠。

translations.literal: The Guanghui and other canals at Anyang were repaired, and the Fuyang River and Wuzhua Canal for the people's benefit at Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Guanghui and other canals at Anyang were repaired, along with the Fuyang River and the Wuzhua People's Canal at Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 九年修江陵枝江沿江堤岸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the riverside dikes at Zhijiang in Jiangling were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 9: the riverside dikes at Zhijiang in Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 築薊州決岸。

translations.literal: The burst banks at Jizhou were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Burst banks at Jizhou were repaired.

sentences.zh: 毀蘇、鬆民私築堤堰。

translations.literal: Privately built dikes and weirs by the people of Suzhou and Song were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Illegal private dikes and weirs in Suzhou and Songjiang were torn down.

sentences.zh: 十年築海鹽潮決海塘千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the tenth year more than 1,500 zhang of seawall were built where sea-salt tides had burst through at Haiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 10: more than 1,500 zhang of seawall were built where tidal breaches had opened at Haiyan.

sentences.zh: 主事沈中言：「山陰西小江，上通金、嚴，下接三江海口，引諸暨、浦江、義烏諸湖水以通舟。

translations.literal: Director Shen Zhong said: "The West Xiaojiang in Shanyin, upstream connecting Jin and Yan, downstream meeting the Sanjiang estuary, draws the waters of Zhuji, Pujiang, Yiwu, and other lakes to pass boats.
translations.idiomatic: Director Shen Zhong reported, "The West Xiaojiang in Shanyin links upstream to Jinhua and Yanzhou and downstream to the Sanjiang estuary, channeling the waters of Zhuji, Pujiang, Yiwu, and other lakes for navigation.

sentences.zh: 江口近淤，宜築臨浦戚堰障諸湖水，俾仍出小江。

translations.literal: The river mouth is recently silted; we should build the Linpu Qi Weir to block the lake waters and still let them out through Xiaojiang.
translations.idiomatic: The mouth has recently silted up; a Linpu Qi Weir should be built to hold back the lake waters while still releasing them through the Xiaojiang.

sentences.zh: 」詔部覆奪。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the ministry to review and decide.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry was ordered to investigate and rule on the proposal.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，修吉安沿江堤。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong the riverside dike at Ji'an was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 1: the riverside dike at Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 築海陽、登雲、都雲、步村等決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Haiyang, Dengyun, Duyun, Bucun, and elsewhere were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Haiyang, Dengyun, Duyun, Bucun, and elsewhere were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚陝西西安灞橋河。

translations.literal: The Baqiao River at Xi'an in Shaanxi was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Baqiao River at Xi'an in Shaanxi was dredged.

sentences.zh: 二年築蠡縣王家等決口。

translations.literal: In the second year breach openings at Wangjia and elsewhere in Li County were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: breach openings at Wangjia and elsewhere in Li County were closed.

sentences.zh: 修新會鸞臺山至瓦塘浦頹岸，江陵、鬆滋、公安、石首、潛江、監利近江決堤。

translations.literal: Collapsed banks from Luan Terrace Mountain to Watang Ford in Xinhui were repaired; and breached dikes near the river at Jiangling, Songzi, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, and Jianli.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed banks from Luan Terrace Mountain to Watang Ford in Xinhui were restored, along with riverine breach dikes at Jiangling, Songzi, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, and Jianli.

sentences.zh: 又修湖廣老龍堤，以為漢水所潰也。

translations.literal: The Laolong Dike in Huguang was also repaired, because it had been breached by Han River water.
translations.idiomatic: The Laolong Dike in Huguang was also restored, having been breached by the Han River.

sentences.zh: 三年疏泰興順德鄉三渠，引湖溉田；

translations.literal: In the third year three canals in Shunde Township, Taixing, were dredged to draw lake water and irrigate fields;
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 3: three canals in Shunde Township, Taixing, were opened to channel lake water for irrigation;

sentences.zh: 潞州永祿等溝渠二十八道，通於漳河。

translations.literal: and twenty-eight ditches including Yonglu at Luzhou were opened to connect with the Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: and twenty-eight ditches including Yonglu at Luzhou were cleared to join the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 四年修容城杜村口堤。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng, was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4: the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng.

sentences.zh: 設正陽門外減水河，並疏城內溝渠。

translations.literal: A flood-relief canal outside Zhengyang Gate was established, and canals within the city were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: A flood-relief canal was opened outside Zhengyang Gate and the city's inner canals were dredged.

sentences.zh: 荊州民言：「城西江水高城十餘丈，霖潦壞堤，水即灌城。

translations.literal: The people of Jingzhou said: "West of the city the river water stands more than ten zhang above the city; when heavy rains destroy the dikes, water floods the city at once.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jingzhou reported, "West of the city the river stands more than ten zhang above the walls; when torrential rains break the dikes, water pours straight into the city.

sentences.zh: 請先事修治。

translations.literal: We ask that repairs be undertaken beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that repairs be carried out in advance.

sentences.zh: 」寧夏巡撫都御史金濂言：「鎮有五渠，資以行溉，今明沙州七星、漢伯、石灰三渠久塞。

translations.literal: " Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Jin Lian of Ningxia said: "The garrison has five canals relied on for irrigation; now at Ming Sha Prefecture the Qixing, Hanbo, and Shihui canals of the three channels have long been blocked.
translations.idiomatic: " Ningxia Grand Coordinator Jin Lian reported, "The garrison relies on five irrigation canals; at Ming Sha Prefecture the Qixing, Hanbo, and Shihui canals have long been choked shut.

sentences.zh: 請用夫四萬疏浚，溉蕪田千三百餘頃。

translations.literal: We ask to employ forty thousand laborers for dredging to irrigate more than 1,300 qing of overgrown fields.
translations.idiomatic: We ask to mobilize forty thousand laborers for dredging to water more than 1,300 qing of fallow fields.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " All petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，修太湖堤，海鹽海岸，南京上中下新河及濟川衛新江口防水堤，漷縣、南宮諸堤。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Taihu dikes, the Haiyan seacoast, Nanjing's upper, middle, and lower new rivers and the flood dikes at the new river mouth of Jichuan Guard, and dikes at Huo County, Nangong, and elsewhere were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 5: Taihu dikes, the Haiyan coast, Nanjing's upper, middle, and lower new rivers and the flood dikes at Jichuan Guard's new river mouth, and dikes at Huo County, Nangong, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 築順天、河間及容城杜村口、郎家口決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Shuntian, Hejian, Dukou Village and Langjiakou in Rongcheng were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Shuntian, Hejian, and at Dukou Village and Langjiakou in Rongcheng were repaired.

sentences.zh: 塞海寧蠣巖決堤口。

translations.literal: The breach opening at the Oyster Rock dike in Haining was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The breach at the Oyster Rock dike in Haining was sealed.

sentences.zh: 浚鹽城伍祐、新興二場運河。

translations.literal: The canal at the Wuyou and Xinxing salt fields in Yancheng was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The transport canal at the Wuyou and Xinxing salt yards in Yancheng was dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，溧水有鎮曰廣通，其西固城湖入大江，東則三塔堰河入太湖。

translations.literal: Initially, in Lishui there was a market town called Guangtong; west of it Gucheng Lake enters the Great River, and east the Santa Weir River enters Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Lishui had a market town called Guangtong: to the west Gucheng Lake joins the Yangtze, and to the east the Santa Weir River flows into Taihu.

sentences.zh: 中間相距十五里，洪武中鑿以通舟。

translations.literal: Between them is a distance of fifteen li; in the Hongwu period a channel was cut for boats.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen li lay between them; under Hongwu a channel was cut for shipping.

sentences.zh: 縣地稍ＡＨ，而湖納甯國、廣德諸水，遇潦即溢，乃築壩於鎮以禦之，而堰水不能至壩下。

translations.literal: The county land is somewhat low-lying, and the lake receives the waters of Ningguo, Guangde, and elsewhere; when floods come it overflows, so a dam was built at the market town to hold it back, yet the weir water could not reach below the dam.
translations.idiomatic: The county lies somewhat low, and the lake takes in the waters of Ningguo, Guangde, and other districts; in flood season it spills over, so a dam was built at the town to hold it back, yet the weir water could not reach below the dam.

sentences.zh: 是歲，改築壩於葉家橋。

translations.literal: That year the dam was rebuilt at Ye Family Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That year the dam was relocated and rebuilt at Ye Family Bridge.

sentences.zh: 胭脂河者，溧水入秦淮道也。

translations.literal: The Yanzhi River is the route by which Lishui enters the Qinhuai.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhi River is Lishui's channel into the Qinhuai.

sentences.zh: 蘇、鬆船皆由以達，沙石壅塞，因並浚之。

translations.literal: Boats from Suzhou and Song all pass through it; sand and stone had blocked it, so it was dredged together with the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou and Songjiang shipping all passed through it, but sand and gravel had choked it, so it was dredged along with the other works.

sentences.zh: 山陽涇河壩，上接漕河，下達鹽城，舊置絞關以通舟，歲久且敝，又恐盜泄水利，遂築塞河口。

translations.literal: The Jinghe Weir Dam at Shanyang, upstream linking the Grand Canal, downstream reaching Yancheng, formerly had winch sluices installed for boats; after long years they were worn, and also lest bandits drain the water works, the river mouth was dammed shut.
translations.idiomatic: At Shanyang the Jinghe Weir Dam links the Grand Canal upstream to Yancheng downstream; winch sluices once allowed passage, but after years of decay—and fear that thieves might drain the works—the mouth was dammed shut.

sentences.zh: 是歲，從民請，修壩並復絞關。

translations.literal: That year, at the people's request, the weir was repaired and the winch sluices restored.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at popular request, the weir was repaired and the winch sluices reopened.

sentences.zh: 六年，造宣武門東城河南岸橋。

translations.literal: In the sixth year a bridge was built on the south bank of the eastern city moat outside Xuanwu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 6: a bridge was built on the south bank of the eastern moat outside Xuanwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 修江米巷玉河橋及堤，並浚京城西南河。

translations.literal: The Yujiang Bridge on the Jade River in Jiangmi Lane and its dike were repaired, and the southwestern river within the capital was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Jade River Bridge in Jiangmi Lane and its embankment were restored, and the southwestern canal within the capital was dredged.

sentences.zh: 築豐城沙月諸河堤、蕪湖陶辛圩新埂。

translations.literal: Dikes on the Shayue and other rivers in Fengcheng were built, and the new embankment of the Taoxin Polder at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes on the Shayue and other rivers at Fengcheng were raised, and a new embankment was built for the Taoxin Polder at Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 浚海寧官河及花塘河、硤石橋塘河，築瓦石堰二所。

translations.literal: The official river and the Huatang and Qiaoshi bridge-pond rivers in Haining were dredged, and two tile-stone weirs were built.
translations.idiomatic: Haining's official river, Huatang River, and Qiaoshi Bridge Pond River were dredged, and two tile-and-stone weirs were constructed.

sentences.zh: 疏南京江洲，殺其水勢，以便修築塌岸。

translations.literal: The Jiangzhou sandbars in Nanjing were dredged to reduce the water's force and facilitate repairing collapsed banks.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing's Jiangzhou sandbars were dredged to ease the current and allow repair of collapsed riverbanks.

sentences.zh: 高郵知州韓簡言：「官河上下二閘皆圮，河亦不通，且子嬰溝塞，減水陰洞閉，致旱澇無所濟。

translations.literal: Han Jian, prefect of Gaoyou, said: "Both upper and lower sluices on the official river are ruined, the river will not pass, and moreover Ziying Ditch is blocked and the flood-relief culvert is closed, so drought and flood alike have no relief.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyou Prefect Han Jian reported, "Both upper and lower sluices on the official river have collapsed and the channel is impassable; Ziying Ditch is silted shut and the flood-relief culvert is closed, leaving drought and flood alike without remedy.

sentences.zh: 俱乞浚治。

translations.literal: We ask that all be dredged and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that all be dredged and restored.

sentences.zh: 」詔部核實以行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the ministry to verify and carry out the work.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry was ordered to verify the facts and proceed.

sentences.zh: 七年，修江西廣昌江岸、蕭山長山浦海塘、彭山通濟堰。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Jiang bank at Guangchang in Jiangxi, the seadike at Changshan Ford in Xiaoshan, and the Tongji Weir at Pengshan were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 7: the riverbank at Guangchang in Jiangxi, the seadike at Changshan Ford in Xiaoshan, and the Tongji Weir at Pengshan.

sentences.zh: 築南京浦子口、大勝關堤，九江及武昌臨江塌岸。

translations.literal: Dikes at Puzikou and Dasheng Pass in Nanjing were built, and collapsed banks along the river at Jiujiang and Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes at Puzikou and Dasheng Pass in Nanjing were raised, and collapsed riverbanks at Jiujiang and Wuchang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚江陵、荊門、潛江淤沙三十餘里。

translations.literal: More than thirty li of silt at Jiangling, Jingmen, and Qianjiang were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty li of silted channel at Jiangling, Jingmen, and Qianjiang were cleared.

sentences.zh: 八年修蘭溪卸橋浦口堤，弋陽官陂三所。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the ford dike at Xieqiao in Lanxi and three official weirs at Yiyang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 8: the ford dike at Xieqiao in Lanxi and three official weirs at Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 浚南京城河。

translations.literal: Nanjing's city moat was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing's city moat was dredged.

sentences.zh: 九年，修德州耿家灣等堤岸、杞縣離溝堤。

translations.literal: In the ninth year dike banks at Geng Family Bay and elsewhere in Dezhou and the Ligou dike in Qi County were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 9: dike banks at Geng Family Bay and elsewhere in Dezhou and the Ligou dike in Qi County.

sentences.zh: 築容城杜村堤決口。

translations.literal: The breach in the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng, was built up.
translations.idiomatic: The breach in the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng, was closed.

sentences.zh: 易上虞菱湖土壩為石閘。

translations.literal: The earthen dam at Linghu in Shangyu was replaced with a stone sluice.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyu's earthen Linghu Dam was replaced with a stone sluice gate.

sentences.zh: 挑無錫裏谷、蘇塘、華港、上村、李走馬塘諸河，東南接蘇州苑山湖塘，北通揚子江，西接新興河，引水灌田。

translations.literal: Ligutang, Sutang, Huagang, Shangcun, Lizoumatang, and other rivers in Wuxi were excavated—southeast connecting to the Garden Mountain lake embankment in Suzhou, north reaching the Yangtze, west joining the Xinxing River—to draw water for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Ligutang, Sutang, Huagang, Shangcun, Lizoumatang, and other canals in Wuxi were excavated—linking southeast to Suzhou's Garden Mountain lake embankment, north to the Yangtze, and west to the Xinxing River—to channel water for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 浚杞縣牛墓岡舊河，武進太平、永興二河。

translations.literal: The old river at Niumugang in Qi County and the Taiping and Yongxing rivers in Wujin were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The old channel at Niumugang in Qi County and the Taiping and Yongxing rivers in Wujin were dredged.

sentences.zh: 疏海鹽永安省，茶市院新涇、陶涇塘諸河。

translations.literal: The Yong'an Quarter in Haiyan and the Xinjing, Taojing Pond, and other rivers at Chashiyuan were opened.
translations.idiomatic: The Yong'an Quarter in Haiyan and the Xinjing, Taojing Pond, and other rivers at Chashiyuan were cleared.

sentences.zh: 都御史陳鎰言：「朝邑多沙鹻，難耕。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Chen Yong said: "Chaoyi has much saline sand and is hard to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Chen Yong reported, "Chaoyi is largely saline sand and hard to cultivate.

sentences.zh: 縣治洛河，與渭水通，請穿渠灌之。

translations.literal: The county seat lies on the Luo River, which connects with the Wei; we ask to cut a canal to irrigate it.
translations.idiomatic: The county seat lies on the Luo River, which joins the Wei; we ask that a canal be cut to irrigate the land.

sentences.zh: 」新安民言：「城南長溝河，西通徐、漕二水，東連雄縣直沽，沙土淤塞，請發丁夫疏浚。

translations.literal: " The people of Xin'an said: "The Changgou River south of the city west joins the Xu and canal waters and east links Xiong County and the Straight Estuary; sand and soil are silted shut—we ask that corvée laborers be sent to dredge it.
translations.idiomatic: " The people of Xin'an reported, "South of the city the Changgou River westward joins the Xu and Grand Canal waters and eastward links Xiong County and the Straight Estuary; sand and silt have choked it—we ask that corvée labor be sent to dredge it.

sentences.zh: 」海陽民蕭瑤言：「縣有長溪，源出山麓，流抵海口，周袤潮郡，故登隆等都俱置溝通溉。

translations.literal: " Xiao Yao of Haiyang said: "The county has a long stream rising from the mountain foothills and reaching the sea mouth, encircling the tide country of Chao prefecture, so Denglong and other districts all had ditches dug for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiao Yao of Haiyang reported, "The county has a long stream rising in the foothills and reaching the sea, encircling Chaozhou; Denglong and other districts therefore all have irrigation ditches.

sentences.zh: 惟隆津等都陸野絕水，歲旱無所賴。

translations.literal: Only Longjin and other districts on open land have no water; in years of drought there is nothing to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Only Longjin and other inland districts lack water entirely and have nothing to fall back on in drought years.

sentences.zh: 乞開溝如登隆。

translations.literal: We ask to open ditches as at Denglong.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that ditches be opened as in Denglong.

sentences.zh: 」長樂民劉彥樑言：「嚴湖二十餘里，南接稠菴溪，西通倒流溪，可備旱溢。

translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere sandy banks fail easily; predecessors built earthen dikes to the northeast and brick revetments to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 今歲久日塌，宜作堤於東流，橫以激之，使合西流，庶無蕩析患。

translations.literal: Now years have long passed and they have daily collapsed; it is fitting to build a dike on the eastward flow and dam it crosswise to drive it, causing it to unite in westward flow—then there may be no scour and breach calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Long neglect has brought collapse—we should build a dike on the eastward course and deflect the flow westward to prevent scour and breach.

sentences.zh: 」都御史項忠言：「涇陽之瓠口鄭、白二渠，引涇水溉田數萬頃，至元猶溉八千頃。

translations.literal: " Censor-in-chief Xiang Zhong said: "The Hulu Kou Zheng and Bai canals at Jingyang draw Jing River water to irrigate tens of thousands of qing; under Yuan they still irrigated eight thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Xiang Zhong reported, "The Zheng and Bai canals at Hulu Kou, Jingyang, once watered tens of thousands of qing; under Yuan they still irrigated eight thousand.

sentences.zh: 其後渠日淺，利因以廢。

translations.literal: Afterward the canals daily grew shallower and the benefit was thereby abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Later the channels silted daily until the works fell idle.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，遣官修鑿，畝收四三石。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuande, officials were dispatched to repair and cut them; per mu four or three shi were harvested.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xuande officials were sent to dredge them and harvests reached three or four shi per mu.

sentences.zh: 無何復塞，渠旁之田，遇旱為赤地。

translations.literal: Before long they silted again; fields beside the canals, when drought came, became bare red earth.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they choked again, and fields along the canals turned bare red clay in drought.

sentences.zh: 涇陽、醴泉、三原、高陵皆患苦之。

translations.literal: Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling all suffered bitterly from this.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling all suffered for it.

sentences.zh: 昨請於涇水上源龍潭左側疏浚，訖舊渠口，尋以詔例停止。

translations.literal: Recently a request was made to dredge on the left of Longtan at the upper source of the Jing, reaching the old canal mouth—but soon it was halted per edict precedent.
translations.idiomatic: A petition recently asked to dredge left of Longtan at the Jing's head down to the old mouth, but work halted under an edict restricting labor.

sentences.zh: 今宜畢其役。

translations.literal: Now it is fitting to complete the task.
translations.idiomatic: The work should now be finished.

sentences.zh: 西安城西井泉堿苦，飲者輒病。

translations.literal: West of Xi'an city the wells and springs are brackish and bitter; those who drink them promptly fall ill.
translations.idiomatic: West of Xi'an the wells are brackish and bitter, and drinkers fall ill.

sentences.zh: 龍首渠引水七十里，修築不易，且利止及城東。

translations.literal: The Longshou Canal draws water seventy li; construction and repair are not easy, and the benefit only reaches east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Longshou Canal brings water seventy li—costly to build and repair, and it only waters the east of the city.

sentences.zh: 西南皁河去城一舍許，可鑿，令引水與龍首渠會，則居民盡利。

translations.literal: Southwest, the Zao River is about one she from the city and can be cut open; if water is led to join the Longshou Canal, then all residents would benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zao River lies a she to the southwest and could be cut open to meet the Longshou Canal, watering all residents.

sentences.zh: 」邳州知州孟琳言：「榆行諸社俱臨沂河，久雨岸崩二十八處，低田盡淹。

translations.literal: " Prefect of Pi Prefecture Meng Lin said: "The various communities of Yuxing all front the Yi River; long rain caused twenty-eight places of bank collapse, and low fields were all inundated.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Meng Lin of Pi reported, "Communities along the Yi have suffered twenty-eight bank collapses in the long rains and low fields are flooded.

sentences.zh: 乞與修築。

translations.literal: We beg to be granted repair and construction.
translations.idiomatic: We ask for repairs.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，修壽州安豐塘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua, Anfeng Pond at Shou Prefecture was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 2 the Anfeng Pond at Shou Prefecture was repaired.

sentences.zh: 四年，疏石州城河。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the city moat at Shi Prefecture was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the moat at Shi Prefecture was dredged.

sentences.zh: 六年，修平湖周家涇及獨山海塘。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Zhoujia Creek at Pinghu and the seawall at Dushan were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Zhoujia Creek at Pinghu and the Dushan seawall were repaired.

sentences.zh: 七年，潮決錢塘江岸及山陰、會稽、蕭山、上虞，乍浦、瀝海二所，錢清諸場。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the tide breached the Qiantang River banks and Shanyin, Kuaiji, Xiaoshan, Shangyu, the two salt offices of Zhapu and Lihai, and the various fields of Qianqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year tide breached the Qiantang estuary banks and coasts of Shanyin, Kuaiji, Xiaoshan, Shangyu, the Zhapu and Lihai salt districts, and the Qianqing pans.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎李顒修築。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Li Yong was ordered to repair and build.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Li Yong was ordered to undertake repairs.

sentences.zh: 八年，堤襄陽決岸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the breached banks at Xiangyang were diked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year breached banks at Xiangyang were restored.

sentences.zh: 十年，廷臣會議：江浦北城圩古溝，北通滁河浦子口；

translations.literal: In the tenth year, court ministers jointly deliberated: the ancient ditch of the north-city polder at Jiangpu, north connecting to Puzikou on the Chu River;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year ministers met: Jiangpu's north-city polder ancient ditch, north to Puzikou on the Chu River;

sentences.zh: 城東黑水泉古溝，南入大江。

translations.literal: the ancient ditch of Heishui Spring east of the city, south entering the Great River.
translations.idiomatic: and east of the city the Heishui Spring ancient ditch, south to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 二溝相望，岡壟中截。

translations.literal: The two ditches face each other, but a ridge in the middle cuts them off.
translations.idiomatic: The two ditches face each other but a ridge between blocks them.

sentences.zh: 宜鑿通成河，旱引澇泄。

translations.literal: It is fitting to cut them through into a river—drawing water in drought and releasing flood.
translations.idiomatic: They should be cut through into one channel, drawing water in drought and draining flood.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，浚杭州錢塘門故渠，左屬湧金門，建橋閘以蓄湖水。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the old canal at Qiantang Gate, Hangzhou, was dredged—left joining Yongjin Gate—and bridge sluices were built to store lake water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Hangzhou dredged the old channel at Qiantang Gate, tying it to Yongjin Gate and building bridge-gates to hold West Lake water.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史牟俸言：「山東小清河，上接濟南趵突諸泉，下通樂安沿海高家港鹽場。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Mu Feng said: "The Xiaoqing River in Shandong upstream receives the springs at Jinan's Baotu and elsewhere, downstream reaching the coastal Gaojia Harbor salt field at Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Mu Feng reported, "Shandong's Xiaoqing River upstream gathers Jinan's Baotu and other springs and downstream reaches the Gaojia Harbor salt works on the Le'an coast.

sentences.zh: 大清河，上接東平坎河諸泉，下通濱州海豐、利津，沿海富國鹽場。

translations.literal: The Daqing River upstream receives the springs of Dongping's Kan River and elsewhere, downstream reaching Haifeng and Lijin at Bin Prefecture and the coastal Fuguo salt field.
translations.idiomatic: The Daqing River upstream takes Dongping's Kan River springs and downstream serves Haifeng and Lijin in Bin Prefecture and the coastal Fuguo salt pans.

sentences.zh: 淤塞，苦盤剝，雨水又患淹沒。

translations.literal: They are silted up, suffering scour and undercutting, and rainwater also brings flooding calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Both are silt-choked, scour undercuts their banks, and rain now brings flooding.

sentences.zh: 勸農參政唐虞浚河造閘，請令兼治水利。

translations.literal: Agricultural Intendant Tang Yu dredged the rivers and built sluices; we ask that he be ordered to oversee water conservancy together.
translations.idiomatic: Agricultural Intendant Tang Yu has dredged the rivers and built gates—please let him also oversee water works.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: " The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 十二年，巡按御史許進言：「河西十五衛，東起莊浪，西抵肅州，綿亙幾二千里，所資水利多奪於勢豪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Investigating Censor Xu Jin said: "The fifteen guards west of the river, from Zhuanglang in the east to Suzhou in the west, stretch nearly two thousand li; the waterworks they rely on are largely seized by powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Investigating Censor Xu Jin reported, "Fifteen guards west of the river from Zhuanglang east to Suzhou west span nearly two thousand li, and much of their irrigation has been seized by powerful families.

sentences.zh: 宜設官專理。

translations.literal: It is fitting to establish an official to manage it exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: A dedicated official should be appointed.

sentences.zh: 」詔屯田僉事兼之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the garrison-lands commissioner to take it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered the garrison-lands commissioner to take the duty concurrently.

sentences.zh: 十四年，俸言：「直隸蘇、鬆與浙西各府，頻年旱澇，緣周環太湖，乃東南最窪地，而蘇、鬆尤最下之沖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Feng said: "Suzhou and Song in the directly administered provinces and the various prefectures of western Zhe, drought and flood in successive years, because encircling Tai Lake they are the lowest ground of the southeast—and Suzhou and Song are especially the lowest flood plain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Feng reported, "Suzhou, Songjiang, and the western Zhe prefectures suffer repeated drought and flood because they ring Tai Lake—the lowest land in the southeast—Suzhou and Songjiang lowest of all.

sentences.zh: 故每逢積雨，眾水奔潰，湖泖漲漫，淹沒無際。

translations.literal: Therefore whenever rains accumulate, the many waters rush and burst forth, lake and marsh rise and spread, inundation without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever rains pile up, waters pour in, lakes and marshes swell, and flooding knows no bounds.

sentences.zh: 按太湖即古震澤，上納嘉、湖、宣、歙諸州之水，下通婁、東、吳淞三江之流，東江今不復見，婁、淞入海故跡具存。

translations.literal: Tai Lake is the ancient Zhen Marsh; upstream it receives the waters of Jiaxing, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, She Prefecture and elsewhere, downstream connecting the flows of Lou, Dong, and Wusong—the three rivers. Dong River is no longer seen today; the old traces of Lou and Song entering the sea all remain.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Lake is the ancient Zhen Marsh, gathering waters from Jiaxing, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, and Shezhou above and discharging through the Lou, Dong, and Wusong rivers below—the Dong branch is gone today, but the old courses of Lou and Wusong to the sea still exist.

sentences.zh: 其地勢與常熟福山、白茆二塘俱能導太湖入江海，使民無墊溺，而土可耕種，歷代開浚具有成法。

translations.literal: Its terrain, together with the Fushan and Baimao dikes at Changshu, can all guide Tai Lake into river and sea, so the people suffer no inundation and the soil can be cultivated—each dynasty's dredging has fixed methods.
translations.idiomatic: Its lay, with Changshu's Fushan and Baimao dikes, can channel Tai Lake to the rivers and sea, spare the people drowning, and keep fields arable—each dynasty's dredging followed established methods.

sentences.zh: 本朝亦常命官修治，不得其要。

translations.literal: Our dynasty also often ordered officials to repair and govern, but without grasping the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty too has often sent officials, but without grasping the essentials.

sentences.zh: 而濱湖豪家盡將淤灘栽蒔為利。

translations.literal: Yet lakeside powerful households all turned silted flats into plantings for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile lakeside magnates have planted every silt flat for private gain.

sentences.zh: 治水官不悉利害，率於泄處置石樑，壅土為道，或慮盜船往來，則釘木為柵。

translations.literal: Water officials did not understand the harm and benefit; routinely at discharge points they set stone beams, heaped earth for roads, or—fearing pirate boats coming and going—drove wooden bars as palisades.
translations.idiomatic: Water officials ignorant of the trade habitually set stone beams and earthen causeways at outfalls, or nailed wooden barriers against pirate craft.

sentences.zh: 以致水道堙塞，公私交病。

translations.literal: Thereby watercourses were choked, public and private alike afflicted.
translations.idiomatic: Channels choked and public and private interests alike suffered.

sentences.zh: 請擇大臣深知水利者專理之，設提督水利分司一員隨時修理，則水勢疏通，東南厚利也。

translations.literal: We ask to select a great minister who deeply understands waterworks to manage it exclusively, establish one supervising sub-commissioner of water conservancy for timely repair—then the water momentum will flow clear and the southeast will gain thick benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Choose a senior minister who truly understands hydraulics, appoint a water-works sub-commissioner for ongoing repair, and the southeast will regain its great profit once the waters run free.

sentences.zh: 」帝即令俸兼領水利，聽所浚築。

translations.literal: " The emperor at once ordered Feng to take water conservancy concurrently, hearing whatever he dredged and built.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor promptly put Feng in charge of water works as well, authorizing whatever dredging and construction he deemed fit.

sentences.zh: 功成，乃專設分司。

translations.literal: When the work was accomplished, then a separate sub-commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: After the work succeeded, a dedicated sub-commission was established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，修南京內外河道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the inner and outer waterways of Nanjing were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Nanjing's inner and outer canals were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十八年，浚雲南東西二溝，自鬆華壩黑龍潭抵西南柳壩南村，灌田數萬頃。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the eastern and western ditches of Yunnan were dredged—from Songhua Dam and Black Dragon Pool to Liuba Nan Village southwest—irrigating tens of thousands of qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Yunnan's eastern and western ditches were dredged from Songhua Dam and Black Dragon Pool to Liuba Nan Village in the southwest, watering tens of thousands of qing.

sentences.zh: 修居庸關水關、城券及隘口水門四十九，樓鋪、墩臺百二。

translations.literal: The water sluices of Juyong Pass, ramparts and vouchers, and forty-nine pass water gates were repaired; one hundred two watch buildings and beacon platforms.
translations.idiomatic: Juyong Pass water gates, ramparts, and forty-nine pass sluices were repaired, along with one hundred two watch buildings and beacon platforms.

sentences.zh: 二十年，修嘉興等六府海田堤岸，特選京堂官往督之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the coastal-field dike banks of six prefectures including Jiaxing were repaired; a capital ministry official was specially chosen to go supervise.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year coastal dikes in six prefectures including Jiaxing were repaired under a specially appointed capital official.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，浚南京中下二新河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the middle and lower two new rivers of Nanjing were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Nanjing's middle and lower new canals were dredged.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年，從巡撫都御史丘鼐言，設官專領灌縣都江堰。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongzhi, following Grand Coordinator Qiu Qi's memorial, an official was established exclusively to oversee the Dujiangyan at Guan County.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 3, acting on Grand Coordinator Qiu Qi's petition, an official was appointed solely to oversee the Dujiangyan at Guan County.

sentences.zh: 六年，敕撫民參政硃瑄浚河南伊、洛，彰德高平、萬金，懷慶廣濟，南陽召公等渠，汝寧桃陂等堰。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an imperial command to Pacification Intendant Zhu Xuan to dredge the Yi and Luo in Henan, the Gaoping and Wanjin canals in Zhangde, the Guangji canal in Huaiqing, the Duke Shao and other canals in Nanyang, and the Taobei and other weirs in Runing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Pacification Intendant Zhu Xuan was ordered to dredge the Yi and Luo in Henan, the Gaoping and Wanjin canals in Zhangde, the Guangji canal in Huaiqing, the Shao Gong and other canals in Nanyang, and the Taobei and other weirs in Runing.

sentences.zh: 七年，浚南京天、潮二河，備軍衛屯田水利。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Tian and Chao rivers of Nanjing were dredged for the waterworks benefit of military guards' garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Nanjing's Tian and Chao rivers were dredged for the garrison irrigation system.

sentences.zh: 七月命侍郎徐貫與都御史何鑒經理浙西水利。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Vice Minister Xu Guan and Censor-in-chief He Jian were ordered to manage the water conservancy of western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Vice Minister Xu Guan and Censor-in-chief He Jian were charged with western Zhe water works.

sentences.zh: 明年四月告成。

translations.literal: The next year in the fourth month the work was reported complete.
translations.idiomatic: The following April they reported completion.

sentences.zh: 貫初奉命，奏以主事祝萃自隨。

translations.literal: At first upon receiving the command, Guan memorialized requesting that Principal Secretary Zhu Cui accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Guan first took up the commission, he memorialized that Principal Secretary Zhu Cui should accompany him.

sentences.zh: 萃乘小舟究悉源委。

translations.literal: Cui took a small boat and thoroughly investigated source and course.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Cui went out in a small boat and traced every source and channel to its end.

sentences.zh: 貫乃令蘇州通判張旻疏各河港水，瀦之大壩。

translations.literal: Guan then ordered Suzhou Vice Prefect Zhang Min to drain the waters of the various river harbors and impound them in the great dam.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guan then had Zhang Min, vice prefect of Suzhou, draw off the waters of the river channels and pond them behind a great earthen dam.

sentences.zh: 旋開白茆港沙面，乘潮退，決大壩水沖激之，沙泥刷盡。

translations.literal: Then he opened the sand surface of Bai Mao Harbor, taking advantage of the ebbing tide, breached the great dam's water to flush and scour it, and sand and mud were entirely washed away.
translations.idiomatic: They next cut open the sand shoals at Bai Mao Harbor; as the tide fell, they broke the dam and let the stored water rush through, scouring away every grain of silt.

sentences.zh: 潮水蕩激，日益闊深，水達海無阻。

translations.literal: Tidal water surged and scoured; daily the channel grew broader and deeper, and water reached the sea without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The tide surged through the cut; day by day the channel grew wider and deeper until water ran freely to the sea.

sentences.zh: 又令浙江參政周季麟修嘉興舊堤三十餘里，易之以石，增繕湖州長興堤岸七十餘里。

translations.literal: He also ordered Zhejiang Administration Commissioner Zhou Jilin to repair the old dike of Jiaxing for more than thirty li, replace it with stone, and additionally repair the dike banks of Changxing in Huzhou for more than seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: He also set Zhejiang Administration Commissioner Zhou Jilin to rebuild more than thirty li of Jiaxing's old dike in stone, and to add more than seventy li of new works on the Changxing banks in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 貫乃上言：「東南財賦所出，而水患為多。

translations.literal: Guan then submitted: "The southeast is where fiscal revenue issues forth, yet water disasters are numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guan then memorialized: "The southeast is the empire's main source of revenue, yet it suffers most from flood.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，命夏原吉疏浚。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle, Xia Yuanji was ordered to dredge and clear.
translations.idiomatic: In early Yongle the court charged Xia Yuanji with dredging the whole system.

sentences.zh: 時以吳淞江氵豔沙浮蕩，未克施工。

translations.literal: At the time because Wusong River's dike-silt and floating shoals drifted about, work could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Wusong's muddy shoals drifted so freely that the work could not proceed.

sentences.zh: 迨今九十餘年，港浦愈塞。

translations.literal: Down to the present more than ninety years, harbors and creeks are ever more blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly a century has passed since, and every harbor and creek has silted tighter still.

sentences.zh: 臣督官行視，浚吳江長橋，導太湖散入氵殿山、陽城、昆承等湖泖。

translations.literal: Your servant supervised officials on inspection tours, dredged Wujiang's Long Bridge, and guided Tai Lake to disperse into the lakes and marshes of Dianshan, Yangcheng, Kun Cheng, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: I supervised inspection teams, dredged the Long Bridge at Wujiang, and opened channels so Tai Lake could spread into Dianshan, Yangcheng, Kun Cheng, and the other backwaters.

sentences.zh: 復開吳淞江並大石、趙屯等浦，泄氵殿山湖水，由吳淞江以達於海。

translations.literal: Again opened Wusong River together with Da Shi, Zhao Tun, and other creeks, to discharge Dianshan lake water and by Wusong River reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: We reopened the Wusong together with Da Shi, Zhao Tun, and other outlets, draining the Dianshan lakes to the sea by way of the Wusong.

sentences.zh: 開白茆港白魚洪、鯰魚口，泄昆承湖水，由白茆港以注於江。

translations.literal: Opened Bai Mao Harbor's Baiyu Flood and Nianyu Mouth, to discharge Kun Cheng lake water and by Bai Mao Harbor pour into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: We cut open Baiyu Flood and Nianyu Mouth on Bai Mao Harbor to send Kun Cheng waters into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 開斜堰、七鋪、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城湖水，由七丫港以達於海。

translations.literal: Opened Xieyan, Qibu, Yantie, and other embanked channels, to discharge Yangcheng lake water and by Qiya Harbor reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: We opened the Xieyan, Qibu, Yantie, and other canals so Yangcheng's waters could reach the sea through Qiya Harbor.

sentences.zh: 下流疏通，不復壅塞。

translations.literal: Lower reaches were cleared and no longer dammed up.
translations.idiomatic: The lower reaches were clear and no longer choked.

sentences.zh: 乃開湖州之漊涇，泄西湖、天目、安吉諸山之水，自西南入於太湖。

translations.literal: Then opened Huzhou's Louding, to discharge the waters of West Lake, Tianmu, Anji, and various mountains, from the southwest entering Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: We opened Louding Creek in Huzhou to bring in the waters of West Lake, Tianmu, Anji, and the western hills into Tai Lake from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 開常州之百瀆，泄溧陽、鎮江、練湖之水，自西北入於太湖。

translations.literal: Opened Changzhou's Hundred Creeks, to discharge the waters of Liyang, Zhenjiang, and Lian Lake, from the northwest entering Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: We opened Changzhou's Hundred Creeks to channel Liyang, Zhenjiang, and Lian Lake waters into Tai Lake from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 又開諸陡門，泄漕河之水，由江陰以入於大江。

translations.literal: Again opened the various steep sluice gates, to discharge the Grand Canal's water and by Jiangyin enter the Great River.
translations.idiomatic: We also opened the steep sluices to release Grand Canal water into the Yangtze through Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 上流亦通，不復堙滯。

translations.literal: Upper reaches were also open and no longer dammed stagnant.
translations.idiomatic: The upper reaches flowed freely as well, no longer backed up.

sentences.zh: 」是役也，修浚河、港、涇、瀆、湖、塘、陡門、堤岸百三十五道，役夫二十餘萬，祝萃之功多焉。

translations.literal: " This project repaired and dredged rivers, harbors, creeks, channels, lakes, embankments, steep gates, and dikes—one hundred thirty-five works in all—with more than two hundred thousand laborers; Zhu Cui's merit was great therein.
translations.idiomatic: " The campaign cleared or rebuilt one hundred thirty-five rivers, harbors, creeks, canals, lakes, embankments, sluices, and dikes, mobilizing more than two hundred thousand workers—and Zhu Cui's contribution was foremost among them.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史王珣言：「寧夏古渠三道，東漢、中唐並通。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Wang Xun said: "Ningxia's three ancient canals—in Eastern Han and mid-Tang were all open.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Xun reported: "Ningxia's three ancient canals all ran clear under the Eastern Han and mid-Tang.

sentences.zh: 惟西一渠傍山，長三百餘里，廣二十餘丈，兩岸危峻，漢、唐舊跡俱堙。

translations.literal: Only the western one canal hugs the mountains, more than three hundred li long, more than twenty zhang wide; both banks precipitous, and Han and Tang old traces are all buried.
translations.idiomatic: Only the western canal along the mountains survives on the books—over three hundred li long and twenty zhang wide, with sheer banks—but every Han and Tang trace has long been buried.

sentences.zh: 宜發卒浚鑿，引水下流。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dispatch soldiers to dredge and cut, and lead water down the course.
translations.idiomatic: We should put troops to digging it out and send the water down again.

sentences.zh: 即以土築東岸，建營堡屯兵以遏寇沖。

translations.literal: At once use earth to build the eastern bank and erect camps and forts with garrison troops to hold back raiders' thrusts.
translations.idiomatic: Earth from the cut could raise the eastern bank, and we could build camps and garrisons to block nomad raids.

sentences.zh: 請帑銀三萬兩，並靈州六年鹽課，以給其費。

translations.literal: Request treasury silver of thirty thousand taels, together with six years of Lingzhou salt tax, to supply the costs.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for thirty thousand taels from the treasury plus six years of Lingzhou salt revenue to pay for it.

sentences.zh: 」又請於靈州金積山河，開渠灌田，給軍民佃種。

translations.literal: " He also requested at Lingzhou's Jijishan River to open a canal to irrigate fields, supplying military and civilians for tenancy cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: " He also proposed opening a canal on the Jijishan River at Lingzhou to irrigate fields for soldiers and civilians to farm.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，修築常熟塘壩，自尚湖口抵江，及黃、泗等浦，新莊等沙三十餘處。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, embankments and dams of Changshu were built and dredged, from Shanghu Mouth to the river, and Huang, Si, and other creeks, and Xinzhuang and other sandbars—more than thirty places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year they built and dredged Changshu's dikes and dams from Shanghu Mouth to the river, along the Huang, Si, and other creeks, and at Xinzhuang and more than thirty other shoals.

sentences.zh: 浚杭州西湖。

translations.literal: Dredged Hangzhou's West Lake.
translations.idiomatic: They dredged Hangzhou's West Lake.

sentences.zh: 正德七年，修廣平滏陽河口堤岸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengde, repaired the dike banks of Guangping's Fuyang River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 7 they repaired the dikes at the mouth of Guangping's Fuyang River.

sentences.zh: 十四年浚南京新江口右河。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year dredged Nanjing's Xinjiangkou right-hand river.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year they dredged the right branch of Nanjing's Xinjiangkou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，御史成英言：「應天等衛屯田在江北滁、和、六合者，地勢低，屢為水敗。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Censor Cheng Ying said: "The garrison fields of Yingtian and other guards north of the Yangtze at Chu, He, and Liuhe have low terrain and are repeatedly ruined by water.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Censor Cheng Ying reported: "Garrison farmland of Yingtian and other guards on the north bank at Chu, He, and Liuhe lies so low that floods ruin it year after year.

sentences.zh: 從金城港抵濁河達烏江三十餘里，因舊跡浚之，則水勢泄而屯田利。

translations.literal: From Jincheng Harbor to Zhuohe reaching Wujiang for more than thirty li, following old traces to dredge it, then water momentum would drain and garrison fields would benefit.
translations.idiomatic: If we dredged the old channel from Jincheng Harbor through Zhuohe to Wujiang—more than thirty li—the flood would drain off and the garrison fields would prosper.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: " An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，築浚束鹿、肥鄉、獻、魏堤渠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing, built and dredged the dike channels of Shulu, Feixiang, Xian, and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 1 they built and dredged the dikes and canals of Shulu, Feixiang, Xian, and Wei.

sentences.zh: 初，蘇、鬆水道盡為勢家所據。

translations.literal: At first, Suzhou and Song waterways were entirely occupied by powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, powerful families had seized control of Suzhou and Songjiang's waterways.

sentences.zh: 巡撫李充嗣畫水為井地，示開鑿法，戶佔一區，計工刻日。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Li Chongsi drew the waterways in a well-field grid, showed the method of opening and cutting, each household occupying one section, calculating labor and fixing dates.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Li Chongsi laid the channels out in a well-field grid, published digging methods, and assigned each household a section with a fixed quota and deadline.

sentences.zh: 造浚川爬，用巨筏數百，曳木齒，隨潮進退，擊汰泥沙。

translations.literal: He built river-dredging harrows, using several hundred great rafts to drag wooden teeth, advancing and retreating with the tide, striking and washing away silt and mud.
translations.idiomatic: He built river-dredging harrows: hundreds of large rafts dragged wooden rakes with the tide, scouring silt as they advanced and retreated.

sentences.zh: 置小艇百餘，尾鐵帚以導之。

translations.literal: He placed more than one hundred small boats, with iron brooms at the stern to guide them.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred small boats followed, iron brooms at their sterns to guide the harrows.

sentences.zh: 浚故道，穿新渠，巨浦支流，罔不灌注。

translations.literal: Dredged the old course, cut new channels; great harbors and branch streams—none failed to receive flow.
translations.idiomatic: They dredged old channels and cut new ones until every main stream and tributary flowed again.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其勞，賚以銀幣。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his labor and bestowed silver coins.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his efforts and rewarded him with silver.

sentences.zh: 二年，修德勝門東、朝陽門北城垣河道，築儀真、江都官塘五區。

translations.literal: In the second year, repaired the city-wall river channels east of Desheng Gate and north of Chaoyang Gate, and built five sections of the official embanked road at Yizhen and Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year they repaired the moat channels east of Desheng Gate and north of Chaoyang Gate, and built five sections of the official causeway at Yizhen and Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 十年，工部郎中陸時雍言：「良鄉盧溝河，涿州琉璃、胡良二河，新城、雄縣白溝河，河間沙河，青縣滹沱河，下流皆淤。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Ministry of Works Director Lu Shiyong said: "Liangxiang's Lugou River, Zhuozhou's Liuli and Huliang rivers, Xincheng and Xiong counties' Baigou River, Hejian's Sha River, Qing county's Hutuo River—downstream all are silted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Director Lu Shiyong of the Ministry of Works reported: "The Lugou at Liangxiang, the Liuli and Huliang at Zhuozhou, the Baigou at Xincheng and Xiong, the Sha at Hejian, and the Hutuo at Qing—all are choked downstream.

sentences.zh: 宜以時浚，使達於海。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dredge in season, so that they reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: They should be dredged on schedule so each can reach the sea again.

sentences.zh: 」詔巡撫議之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the grand coordinator to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " The court told the grand coordinator to study the plan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，太僕卿何棟勘畿封河患有二。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Court of Imperial Studs Minister He Dong surveyed river disasters of the capital region and found two.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Minister He Dong of the Court of Imperial Studs surveyed capital-region river troubles and identified two problems.

sentences.zh: 一論滹沱河。

translations.literal: One concerned the Hutuo River.
translations.idiomatic: The first concerned the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 其一言：「真定鴨、沙、磁三河，俱發源五臺。

translations.literal: The first statement said: "Zhending's Ya, Sha, and Ci rivers all rise on Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: On the first he wrote: "Zhending's Ya, Sha, and Ci rivers all rise on Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 會諸支水，抵唐河蘭家圈，合流入河間。

translations.literal: They meet the various branch waters, reach Tang River's Lanjia Quan, and together flow into Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Their branches converge at Lanjia Quan on the Tang River and flow on into Hejian.

sentences.zh: 東南經任丘、霸州、天津入海，此故道也。

translations.literal: Southeast passing Renqiu, Bazhou, and Tianjin to enter the sea—this is the old course.
translations.idiomatic: From there the old course ran southeast through Renqiu, Bazhou, and Tianjin to the sea.

sentences.zh: 河間東南高，東北下，故水決蘭家口，而肅寧、新安皆罹其害。

translations.literal: Hejian's southeast is high and northeast low, so water broke Lanjia Mouth, and Suning and Xin'an all suffered its harm.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian is higher to the southeast and lower to the northeast, so the river burst at Lanjia Mouth and Suning and Xin'an were inundated.

sentences.zh: 宜築決口，浚故道。

translations.literal: It is fitting to build the breach and dredge the old course.
translations.idiomatic: We should close the breach and reopen the old channel.

sentences.zh: 涿州胡良河，自拒馬分流，至州東入渾河。

translations.literal: Zhuozhou's Huliang River, from the Juma dividing flow, reaches the east of the prefecture and enters the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuozhou's Huliang branches from the Juma, runs to the east of the prefecture, and enters the Hun.

sentences.zh: 良鄉琉璃河，發源磁家務，潛入地中，至良鄉東入渾河。

translations.literal: Liangxiang's Liuli River rises at Cijiawu, sinks underground, and at the east of Liangxiang enters the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: Liangxiang's Liuli rises at Cijiawu, runs underground, and emerges east of Liangxiang to join the Hun.

sentences.zh: 比者渾河壅塞，二河不流。

translations.literal: Recently the Hun River has been blocked, and the two rivers do not flow.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the Hun has silted up and neither river runs.

sentences.zh: 然下流淤沙僅四五里，請亟浚之。

translations.literal: Yet downstream silt is only four or five li; request urgently to dredge it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet downstream the blockage is only four or five li—please dredge it at once.

sentences.zh: 」部覆允行。

translations.literal: " The ministry reviewed and approved implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry approved and ordered the work carried out.

sentences.zh: 郎中徐元祉受命振災，上言：「河本以泄水，今反下壅；

translations.literal: Director Xu Yuanzhi, receiving command to relieve disaster, submitted: "Rivers originally are to drain water, yet now they dam up below;
translations.idiomatic: Director Xu Yuanzhi, charged with disaster relief, memorialized: "Rivers exist to carry water off, yet now they back up downstream;

sentences.zh: 澱本以瀦水，今反上溢。

translations.literal: marshes originally are to hold water, yet now they overflow above.
translations.idiomatic: marshes exist to store water, yet now they spill upstream.

sentences.zh: 故畿輔常苦水，順天利害相半，真定利多於害，保定害多於利，河間全受其害。

translations.literal: Therefore the capital region constantly suffers from water; Shuntian's benefit and harm are half and half, Zhending's benefit exceeds harm, Baoding's harm exceeds benefit, and Hejian wholly receives its harm.
translations.idiomatic: That is why the capital region is chronically flooded: Shuntian sees equal gain and loss, Zhending gains more than it loses, Baoding loses more than it gains, and Hejian bears the full brunt.

sentences.zh: 弘、正間，嘗築長堤，排決口，旋即潰敗。

translations.literal: Between Hongzhi and Zhengde, long dikes were sometimes built and breach mouths closed, yet they immediately burst and failed.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongzhi and Zhengde they built long dikes and sealed breaches, only to see them fail at once.

sentences.zh: 今惟疏浚可施，其策凡六。

translations.literal: Now only dredging can be applied; the policies are six in all.
translations.idiomatic: Only dredging will serve now; he offered six measures.

sentences.zh: 一浚本河，俾河身寬邃。

translations.literal: First, dredge the main river, so the river body is broad and deep.
translations.idiomatic: First, dredge the main channel until the river is wide and deep.

sentences.zh: 九河自山西來者，南合滹沱而不侵真定諸郡，北合白溝而不侵保定諸郡。

translations.literal: The Nine Rivers coming from Shanxi—south joining the Hutuo without encroaching on Zhending's various prefectures, north joining the Baigou without encroaching on Baoding's various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Nine Rivers from Shanxi join the Hutuo on the south without flooding Zhending, and the Baigou on the north without flooding Baoding.

sentences.zh: 此第一義也。

translations.literal: This is the first principle.
translations.idiomatic: That is the first principle.

sentences.zh: 一浚支河。

translations.literal: Second, dredge branch rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Second, clear the branch channels.

sentences.zh: 令九河之流，經大清河，從紫城口入；

translations.literal: Let the Nine Rivers' flow pass the Daqing River and enter through Zicheng Mouth;
translations.idiomatic: Route the Nine Rivers through the Daqing, in at Zicheng Mouth;

sentences.zh: 經文都村，從涅槃口入；

translations.literal: pass Wendu village and enter through Niepan Mouth;
translations.idiomatic: through Wendu village, in at Niepan Mouth;

sentences.zh: 經白洋澱，從蘭家口入；

translations.literal: pass Baiyang Marsh and enter through Lanjia Mouth;
translations.idiomatic: through Baiyang Marsh, in at Lanjia Mouth;

sentences.zh: 經章哥ＡＨ，從楊村河入。

translations.literal: pass Zhangge Marsh and enter through Yangcun River.
translations.idiomatic: through Zhangge Marsh, in at the Yangcun River.

sentences.zh: 直遂以納細流，水力分矣。

translations.literal: Straight and swift to receive fine streams—the water force is divided.
translations.idiomatic: Each run should be straight and swift to take the lesser flows and divide the force of the flood.

sentences.zh: 一浚決河。

translations.literal: Third, dredge breach rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Third, manage the breach channels.

sentences.zh: 九河安流時，本支二河可受，遇漲則岸口四沖。

translations.literal: When the Nine Rivers flow peacefully, the main and branch two rivers can receive them; when they rise, the banks' mouths rush in four directions.
translations.idiomatic: When the Nine Rivers run calm, the main and branch channels can hold them; when they swell, water bursts the banks in every direction.

sentences.zh: 宜每衝量存一口，復浚令合成一渠，以殺湍急，備淫溢。

translations.literal: It is fitting at each rush to keep one mouth, again dredge and make them merge into one channel, to reduce swift turbulence and guard against excessive flood.
translations.idiomatic: At each breakout keep one outlet, dredge them into a single channel, and slow the torrent before it spills everywhere.

sentences.zh: 一浚澱河。

translations.literal: Fourth, dredge marsh rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, dredge the marsh channels.

sentences.zh: 令澱澱相通，達於本支二河，使下有所泄。

translations.literal: Let marshes connect with one another, reaching the main and branch two rivers, so below there is somewhere to drain.
translations.idiomatic: Link the marshes to one another and to the main and branch rivers so the lowlands have somewhere to drain.

sentences.zh: 一浚淤河。

translations.literal: Fifth, dredge silted rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, clear silted channels.

sentences.zh: 九河東逝，悉由故道，高者下，下者通。

translations.literal: The Nine Rivers flowing east all follow the old course—where high, lower; where low, open.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Nine Rivers running east follow their old beds—cut down the high, open the low.

sentences.zh: 佔據曲防者抵罪。

translations.literal: Those who occupy and bend to block are punished.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who blocks the course with private dikes shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 一浚下河。

translations.literal: Sixth, dredge lower rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, dredge the lower reaches.

sentences.zh: 九河一出青縣，一出丁字沽，二流相匝於苑家口。

translations.literal: The Nine Rivers—one exits Qing county, one exits Dingzigou; the two flows encircle at Yuanjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: One Nine River arm leaves Qing county, another leaves Dingzigou; the two meet and circle at Yuanjiakou.

sentences.zh: 故施工必自苑家口始，漸有成效，然後次第舉行，庶減諸郡水害。

translations.literal: Therefore construction must begin at Yuanjiakou; gradually there will be effect, and then proceed in order, so that the various prefectures' water harm may be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Work must therefore begin at Yuanjiakou; only after results appear there should the rest proceed in turn, easing flood across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved the plan with praise.

sentences.zh: 明年，香河郭家莊自開新河一道，長百七十丈，闊五十丈，近舊河十里餘。

translations.literal: The next year, at Xianghe's Guojiazhuang a new river channel opened itself, one hundred seventy zhang long and fifty zhang wide, near the old river by more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: The following year at Guojiazhuang in Xianghe a new channel opened on its own—one hundred seventy zhang long and fifty wide—running parallel to the old river more than ten li away.

sentences.zh: 詔河官亟繕治。

translations.literal: An edict ordered river officials urgently to repair and govern.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered river officials to repair it at once.

sentences.zh: 十三年，巡撫都御史周金言：「蘭家圈決口，塞之則東溢，病河間；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Zhou Jin said: "Lanjia Quan's breach—if blocked then it overflows east and harms Hejian;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Grand Coordinator Zhou Jin reported: "At the breach in Lanjia Quan, sealing it floods Hejian to the east;

sentences.zh: 不塞則東流漸淤，病保定。

translations.literal: if not blocked then the east flow gradually silts, harming Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: leaving it open lets the eastern channel silt up and harms Baoding.

sentences.zh: 宜存決口而浚廣新河，使水東北平流，無壅涸患。

translations.literal: It is fitting to keep the breach and dredge and widen the new river, so water flows level east and north without damming-up and drying harm.
translations.idiomatic: We should keep the breach open and widen the new channel so water runs evenly east and north without choking or drying out.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，浚南京後湖。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, dredged Nanjing's Rear Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year they dredged Nanjing's Rear Lake.

sentences.zh: 初，胡體乾按吳，以松江泛溢，進六策：「曰開川，曰浚湖，曰殺上流之勢，曰決下流之壑，曰排潮漲之沙，曰立治田之規。

translations.literal: At first, Hu Tigian inspected Wu, and because Songjiang broadly overflowed, advanced six policies: "namely open channels, dredge lakes, reduce the momentum of upper streams, open the gullies of lower streams, discharge tidal sand's rise, and establish regulations for governing fields.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while inspecting Wu, Hu Tigian had proposed six remedies for Songjiang's chronic flooding: open main channels, dredge lakes, ease upstream pressure, clear downstream outlets, flush away tidal silt, and set rules for field management.

sentences.zh: 是年，呂光洵按吳，復奏蘇、鬆水利五事：

translations.literal: That year, Lü Guangxun inspected Wu, and again memorialized five matters of Suzhou and Song water conservancy:
translations.idiomatic: That same year Lü Guangxun, inspecting Wu, memorialized five points on Suzhou and Songjiang water works:

sentences.zh: 一曰廣疏浚以備瀦泄。

translations.literal: First, broadly dredge and clear to prepare impounding and draining.
translations.idiomatic: First, dredge broadly to secure both storage and release.

sentences.zh: 三吳澤國，西南受太湖諸澤，水勢尤卑。

translations.literal: The Three Wu are a marsh country; the southwest receives the various marshes of Tai Lake, and water momentum is especially low.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Wu form a water country: the southwest takes Tai Lake and its feeder marshes, and the land lies especially low.

sentences.zh: 東北際海，岡隴之地，視西南特高。

translations.literal: The northeast borders the sea; ridge-and-mound land compared with the southwest is especially high.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast lies the sea, where ridges and mounds stand far higher than the southwest.

sentences.zh: 高苦旱，卑苦澇。

translations.literal: The high suffer drought; the low suffer flood.
translations.idiomatic: The high ground thirsts in drought; the low drowns in flood.

sentences.zh: 昔人於下流疏為塘浦，導諸湖水北入江，東入海，又引江潮流衍於岡隴外。

translations.literal: Men of old on the lower reaches dredged embanked creeks, guiding the various lake waters north into the river and east into the sea, and also drew the Yangtze's tidal flow to spread beyond the ridges.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients cut embanked creeks on the lower reaches to send lake water north into the Yangtze and east into the sea, and led tidal water from the Yangtze onto the higher ground beyond the ridges.

sentences.zh: 瀦泄有法，水旱無患。

translations.literal: Impounding and draining had method; flood and drought were without worry.
translations.idiomatic: With proper storage and release, flood and drought ceased to be a scourge.

sentences.zh: 比來縱浦橫塘，多堙不治，惟黃浦、劉河二江頗通。

translations.literal: Recently, letting creeks and cross-dikes run wild, many are buried and not governed; only Huangpu and Liuhe two rivers are rather open.
translations.idiomatic: Lately creeks and cross-dikes have been neglected until most are choked; only the Huangpu and Liuhe remain fairly clear.

sentences.zh: 然太湖之水源多勢盛，二江不足以泄之。

translations.literal: Yet Tai Lake's water sources are many and momentum strong; the two rivers are insufficient to drain them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tai Lake has many sources and tremendous volume—two rivers cannot carry it off.

sentences.zh: 岡隴支河又多壅絕，無以資灌溉。

translations.literal: The branch rivers of the ridges again were mostly blocked and cut off, with no means to supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Branch channels through the uplands were again choked shut, leaving no water for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 於是高下俱病，歲常告災。

translations.literal: Thereupon high and low alike suffered harm, and the year constantly reported calamity.
translations.idiomatic: High ground and low ground alike fell ill, and almost every year brought disaster reports.

sentences.zh: 宜先度要害，於氵殿山等茭蘆地，導太湖水散入陽城、昆承、三泖等湖。

translations.literal: One should first survey the critical points; at Dianshan and other reed-mat areas, guide Tai Lake water to disperse into Yangcheng, Kun-Cheng, and the Three Mo lakes.
translations.idiomatic: They should first survey the choke points and, at Dianshan and other reed flats, channel Tai Lake water into Yangcheng, Kun-Cheng, and the Three Mo lakes.

sentences.zh: 又開吳淞江及大石、趙屯等浦，泄澱山之水以達於海。

translations.literal: Also open the Wusong River and Dashi, Zhaotun, and other creeks to drain Dianshan's waters to reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Open the Wusong River and creeks such as Dashi and Zhaotun to carry off Dianshan's waters to the sea.

sentences.zh: 浚白茆、鯰魚諸口，泄昆承之水以注於江。

translations.literal: Dredge Baimao, Nianyu, and other mouths to drain Kun-Cheng's waters to pour into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Dredge the mouths at Baimao, Nianyu, and elsewhere to send Kun-Cheng's waters down to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 開七浦、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城之水以達於江。

translations.literal: Open Qipu, Yantie, and other ponds to drain Yangcheng's waters to reach the river.
translations.idiomatic: Open the Qipu, Yantie, and other channel-ponds to carry Yangcheng's waters to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 又導田間之水，悉入小浦，以納大浦，使流者皆有所歸，瀦者皆有所泄。

translations.literal: Also guide field waters all into small creeks to admit into large creeks, so that flowing water all has where to go and impounded water all has where to drain.
translations.idiomatic: Field runoff should be led into minor creeks and then into major ones, so every current had an outlet and every pool a drain.

sentences.zh: 則下流之地治，而澇無所憂矣。

translations.literal: Then the lower-reach lands would be governed, and flood would have nothing to worry about.
translations.idiomatic: The lowlands would then be brought under control, and flooding would cease to be a threat.

sentences.zh: 乃浚艾祁、通波以溉青浦，浚顧浦、吳塘以溉嘉定，浚大瓦等浦以溉崑山之東，浚許浦等塘以溉常熟之北，浚臧村等港以溉金壇，浚澡港等河以溉武進。

translations.literal: Thereupon dredge Aiqi and Tongbo to irrigate Qingpu, dredge Gupu and Wutang to irrigate Jiading, dredge Dawapu and other creeks to irrigate eastern Kunshan, dredge Xupu and other ponds to irrigate northern Changshu, dredge Zangcun and other harbors to irrigate Jintan, dredge Zaogang and other rivers to irrigate Wujin.
translations.idiomatic: Dredge the Aiqi and Tongbo channels to water Qingpu; Gupu and Wutang for Jiading; Dawapu and like channels for eastern Kunshan; Xupu and similar ponds for northern Changshu; Zangcun and other harbors for Jintan; Zaogang and other rivers for Wujin.

sentences.zh: 凡隴岡支河堙塞不治者，皆浚之深廣，使復其舊。

translations.literal: All ridge branch rivers buried and blocked and not governed—dredge them deep and broad to restore their former state.
translations.idiomatic: Every choked branch channel through the uplands should be dredged deep and wide until restored to its former capacity.

sentences.zh: 則上流之地亦治，而旱無所憂矣。

translations.literal: Then the upper-reach lands too would be governed, and drought would have nothing to worry about.
translations.idiomatic: The highlands too would be secured, and drought would cease to be a threat.

sentences.zh: 此三吳水利之經也。

translations.literal: This is the classic canon of Three Wu water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the enduring canon of hydraulic policy in the Three Wu region.

sentences.zh: 一曰修圩岸以固橫流。

translations.literal: Second, repair polder dikes to firm against cross-flow.
translations.idiomatic: Second, restore polder dikes to hold back lateral currents.

sentences.zh: 蘇、鬆、常、鎮東南下流，而蘇、鬆又常、鎮下流，易瀦難泄。

translations.literal: Suzhou, Song, Chang, and Zhen flow southeast downward, while Suzhou and Song are again below Chang and Zhen, easy to impound and hard to drain.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang drain southeastward; Suzhou and Songjiang lie below Changzhou and Zhenjiang, where water ponds easily and drains with difficulty.

sentences.zh: 雖導河浚浦引注江海，而秋霖泛漲，風濤相薄，則河浦之水逆行田間，沖齧為患。

translations.literal: Although rivers are guided and creeks dredged to draw and pour into river and sea, when autumn rains flood and swell and wind and waves beat together, then river and creek waters run backward through the fields, eroding and gnawing as harm.
translations.idiomatic: Even with rivers dredged and channels led to the Yangtze and sea, autumn floods and wind-driven surges could drive water back through the fields, scouring the land.

sentences.zh: 宋轉運使王純臣嘗令蘇、湖作田塍禦水，民甚便之。

translations.literal: Song transport commissioner Wang Chunchen once ordered Suzhou and Hu to make field ridges against water; the people found it very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: During the Song, Transport Commissioner Wang Chunchen had Suzhou and the lake districts build field ridges against floodwater, to great popular benefit.

sentences.zh: 司農丞郟亦云：「治河以治田為本。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue aide Xing also said: "Governing rivers takes governing fields as root.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry aide Xing Yun also said, "River work must take field work as its foundation.

sentences.zh: 」故老皆云，前二三十年，民間足食，因餘力治圩岸，田益完美。

translations.literal: " Therefore the old all say, in the previous twenty or thirty years the people had enough food and, by surplus strength, governed polder dikes; fields grew daily more perfect.
translations.idiomatic: " The elders all recalled that twenty or thirty years earlier the people ate their fill and, with labor to spare, kept the polder dikes in repair until the farmland grew ever more perfect.

sentences.zh: 近皆空乏，無暇修繕，故田圩漸壞，歲多水災。

translations.literal: Recently all are depleted and empty, with no leisure to repair, so field polders gradually ruin and years often have flood calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Lately households were impoverished, with no time for maintenance; polders decayed and flood disasters came year after year.

sentences.zh: 合敕所在官司專治圩岸。

translations.literal: It is fitting to decree that the offices in each place specially govern polder dikes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict should order every local office to maintain the polder dikes as its dedicated duty.

sentences.zh: 岸高則田自固，雖有霖澇，不能為害。

translations.literal: If dikes are high then fields naturally are firm; even if there is rainy flood, it cannot become harm.
translations.idiomatic: High dikes would keep the fields secure; even in torrential seasons they would suffer little harm.

sentences.zh: 且足制諸湖之水鹹歸河浦中，則不待決泄，自然湍流。

translations.literal: Moreover it suffices to control the lakes' brackish water to return into river and creeks, then without waiting to breach and drain, naturally swift flow.
translations.idiomatic: They would also confine lake brine within the channel network, so water would race through without emergency breaches.

sentences.zh: 而岡隴之地，亦因江水稍高，又得畝引以資灌溉，不特利於低田而已。

translations.literal: And ridge lands, also because river water is slightly high, may again draw by mu to supply irrigation—not only benefiting low fields alone.
translations.idiomatic: Upland fields could draw the slightly higher river water acre by acre for irrigation—not a benefit confined to the lowlands alone.

sentences.zh: 一曰復板閘以防汙氵殿。

translations.literal: Third, restore plank sluices to guard against silting.
translations.idiomatic: Third, restore plank sluice gates to hold back silt deposition.

sentences.zh: 河浦之水皆自平原流入江海，水慢潮急，以故沙隨浪湧，其勢易淤。

translations.literal: River and creek waters all flow from the plain into river and sea; water is slow, tide is swift, therefore sand follows waves to surge—its momentum easily silts.
translations.idiomatic: Channel water moved sluggishly from the plain toward river and sea while the tide ran swift, so sand surged with the waves and silt built up easily.

sentences.zh: 昔人權其便宜，去江海十里許夾流為閘，隨潮啟閉，以禦淤沙。

translations.literal: Men of old weighed convenience, ten li or so from river and sea split the flow to make sluices, opening and closing with the tide to defend against silt sand.
translations.idiomatic: Forebears had weighed convenience and built sluice gates roughly ten li from the estuary, opening and closing with the tide to hold back silt.

sentences.zh: 歲旱則長閉以蓄其流，歲澇則長啟以宣其溢，所謂置閘有三利，蓋謂此也。

translations.literal: In drought years then keep long closed to store the flow; in flood years keep long open to release the overflow—the so-called placing sluices has three benefits, this is what is meant.
translations.idiomatic: In drought the gates stayed shut to hoard water; in flood they stayed open to discharge the surplus—the "three benefits of sluice gates" meant precisely this.

sentences.zh: 近多堙塞，惟常熟福山閘尚存。

translations.literal: Recently many are buried and blocked; only Changshu Fushan Sluice still exists.
translations.idiomatic: Most had since silted shut; only the Fushan sluice at Changshu remained.

sentences.zh: 故老以為河浦入海之地，誠皆置閘，自可曆久不壅。

translations.literal: The old believe that at river and creek places entering the sea, if all truly place sluices, naturally they can pass long years without blockage.
translations.idiomatic: The elders held that if sluices were restored at every estuary, the channels could stay clear for years on end.

sentences.zh: 一曰量緩急以處工費。

translations.literal: Fourth, measure urgency and ease to dispose labor and expense.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, gauge urgency and ease when allocating labor and funds.

sentences.zh: 一曰重委任以責成功。

translations.literal: Fifth, weightily entrust duty to charge success.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, invest officials with real authority and hold them accountable for results.

sentences.zh: 詔悉如議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all as discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the entire proposal.

sentences.zh: 光洵因請專委巡撫歐陽必進。

translations.literal: Guangxun thereupon asked to specially entrust Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijing.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Guangxun asked that overall responsibility be given to Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijing.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: His request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，給事中陳斐請仿江南水田法，開江北溝洫，以祛水患，益歲收。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, supervising secretary Chen Fei asked to imitate Jiangnan paddy-field methods and open Jiangbei ditches and canals to expel water harm and increase yearly harvest.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26, Supervising Secretary Chen Fei proposed adopting Jiangnan paddy methods to open ditches and canals in northern Jiangsu, easing floods and raising the harvest.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Report approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，總督尚書楊博請開宣、大荒田水利。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, supreme commissioner minister Yang Bo asked to open Xuan and Da wasteland field water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 38, supreme commissioner Yang Bo memorialized to develop waterworks for wasteland in Xuanzhou and Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Granted.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史翁大立言：「東吳水利，自震澤浚源以注江，三江導流以入海，而蘇州三十六浦，松江八匯，毘陵十四瀆，共以節宣旱澇。
